Are you ready to be a big part of something big?

At Trader Interactive, we make buying and selling a great experience. We’re a group of go-getters who decided they didn’t want to settle for the status quo. We come together as one team to build value and drive innovation across our industries - but we have fun while we do it and make sure our people are always our #1 priority.

When it comes to your career, we want to provide big opportunities to help you make a big impact. But for this to be possible, we strive to feel small. Small enough to quickly change tack, small enough to learn from different teams and small enough to connect authentically with leadership.

What We Offer

  • An inclusive and supportive work environment where you can move your career forward and will have the chance to do work that has real, significant impact on the world.

  • The opportunity to be a part of a global group of digital marketplace businesses (CAR Group) located across Australia, Brazil, Chile and South Korea - collectively we have around 2,500 team members worldwide, and our CAR Group Tour means you might just find yourself working in one of those businesses sometime soon.

  • Plenty of flexible leave options and employee benefits including up to 31 days of paid time off in your first year, continuing education with access to LinkedIn Learning, a full benefits package including medical, dental & vision, 401K with company match, and wellness program.

What You’ll Do

The CRM Product Specialist is a quota-carrying, new-business hunter responsible for driving net new logo acquisition across DP360's Commercial Truck, Marine, Equipment and Recreational vertical markets. This is a full-cycle sales role; from prospecting and pipeline generation through discovery, demonstration, negotiation and close — selling DP360's operational software suite including CRM and Conversational AI solutions to dealership groups and operators.

Working in concert with SDR support, channel and referral partnerships and self-sourced outbound activity, the Product Specialist owns revenue growth in their assigned territory. This is a high-impact, individual contributor role modeled after best-in-class SaaS acquisition motions seen at large enterprise SaaS companies — structured for reps who thrive in complex, consultative sales environments and are energized by building new customer relationships.

Pipeline Generation & Prospecting

  • Execute a balanced prospecting motion across self-sourced outbound, SDR qualified inbound, and channel/referral-sourced leads.

  • Build and maintain a minimum 3x pipeline coverage ratio against quota at all times.

  • Develop territory and account-level prospecting plans targeting Commercial (powersports, RV, marine, construction equipment) and Recreational verticals.

  • Leverage referral networks within the broader Trader Interactive ecosystem to identify cross-sell and co-sell opportunities.

  • Partner closely with SDR team to refine messaging, qualify inbound interest and convert MQLs to SQLs efficiently.

Sales Execution & Deal Management

  • Own the full sales cycle from initial discovery call through signed contract, typically 60-120 days depending on deal complexity.

  • Conduct compelling discovery sessions to understand dealership workflow, technology gaps and performance objectives.

  • Deliver tailored product demonstrations of DP360 CRM and Conversational AI tools to dealership operators, GMs, and ownership groups.

  • Build multi-threaded relationships with economic buyers, champions and end users within prospect accounts.

  • Develop and deliver ROI-based business cases and proposals aligned to each prospect's operational metrics and KPIs.

  • Manage deal progression in CRM with accurate forecasting, stage discipline and pipeline hygiene at all times.

Channel & Partner Collaboration

  • Develop and nurture relationships with referral partners, OEM contacts and adjacent Trader Interactive business units to drive inbound deal flow.

  • Coordinate with channel partners on joint pipeline reviews, co-selling motions and shared account strategies.

  • Act as a DP360 brand ambassador at industry events, dealer associations and trade shows within target verticals.

Cross-Functional Alignment

  • Collaborate with the CRM Performance Manager (Customer Success) to ensure smooth post-sale handoff and maximize early customer engagement.

  • Feed competitive intelligence, objection patterns and prospect feedback to Product, Marketing, Marketplace Sales and Leadership teams on a structured basis.

  • Support go-to-market initiatives including beta launches, product releases and vertical-specific marketing campaigns.

  • Partner with Marketing to refine ICP targeting, messaging and campaign effectiveness based on field insights.

What We’re Looking For

  • 3–5+ years of quota-carrying SaaS sales experience in a full-cycle Account Executive or equivalent role.

  • Demonstrated track record of consistent quota attainment at or above 100%.

  • Experience selling operational or vertical SaaS solutions to SMB and mid-market customers ($15K–$75K ACV).

  • Strong command of consultative selling methodologies (Challenger or equivalent).

  • Proven ability to self-source pipeline through outbound prospecting in addition to working inbound and partner-referred leads.

  • Excellent discovery, presentation, and negotiation skills with comfort presenting to C-suite and ownership-level buyers.

  • Data-literate and CRM-disciplined — experience maintaining accurate pipeline in Salesforce, HubSpot or equivalent.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience selling into automotive, powersports, RV, marine, or equipment dealership verticals.

  • Familiarity with CRM platforms, dealership management systems (DMS), or Conversational AI/messaging products.

  • Background selling within a SaaS portfolio (e.g., Coupa, Anaplan, DealerSocket, VinSolutions, vAuto).

  • Experience working in a channel-assisted or partner co-sell sales environment.

  • Comfort with product-led growth motions and shorter, transactional deal cycles alongside complex enterprise sales.

So come and join our team - because every role is a big role in our plans to go big.

TI proudly supports a diverse workforce, and we encourage candidates from underrepresented groups to apply. Trader Interactive is an equal opportunity employer where hiring is based entirely on business needs, job requirements, and individual merit.

Position Summary

Ironmark is seeking a strategic, analytical, and client-focused Senior Digital Marketing Strategist to lead integrated marketing strategy across a portfolio of client accounts.

This role serves as the strategic bridge between client business objectives and marketing execution, partnering with clients, account teams, and channel specialists to develop growth-focused strategies that drive measurable business outcomes. The Senior Digital Marketing Strategist is responsible for aligning marketing initiatives across the customer journey, translating performance data into actionable recommendations, and ensuring execution supports broader business goals.

The ideal candidate combines strong business acumen, marketing expertise, and analytical thinking with the ability to build trusted client relationships and influence cross-functional teams. This role does not directly manage personnel but plays a critical leadership role in shaping strategy, guiding execution, and driving client success.

Key Responsibilities

Client Strategy & Leadership

  • Serve as the primary strategic advisor for assigned client accounts.
  • Lead strategic planning initiatives, quarterly business reviews, growth discussions, and client consultations.
  • Translate business goals into integrated marketing strategies and actionable roadmaps.
  • Present strategic recommendations, performance insights, and growth opportunities to client stakeholders.
  • Build trusted relationships through proactive consultation and strategic guidance.

Integrated Marketing Strategy

  • Develop and oversee integrated marketing strategies across paid media, SEO, AEO, content marketing, email marketing, local marketing, analytics, and emerging digital channels.
  • Ensure channel initiatives work cohesively throughout the customer journey and support business objectives.
  • Collaborate with channel specialists to align tactical execution with strategic priorities.
  • Identify opportunities to improve performance through audience targeting, conversion optimization, content alignment, media mix adjustments, and cross-channel coordination.
  • Stay informed on emerging technologies, AI-driven search experiences, and evolving consumer behavior.

Performance & Growth Planning

  • Analyze marketing performance data to identify trends, opportunities, risks, and growth drivers.
  • Translate insights into actionable recommendations for clients and internal teams.
  • Develop testing roadmaps and optimization plans designed to improve business outcomes.
  • Recommend channel investment strategies and budget allocation.
  • Identify opportunities for account growth and expanded service adoption.
  • Lead strategic onboarding and discovery efforts for new client engagements.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Paid Media, SEO, Content, Creative, Analytics, Development, Local Marketing, and Account Management teams to ensure coordinated execution.
  • Provide strategic guidance while respecting channel ownership and subject matter expertise.
  • Support internal teams with market research, competitive insights, and strategic recommendations.
  • Contribute to agency thought leadership, process improvements, and strategic best practices.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 4–7 years of experience in digital marketing, growth marketing, account strategy, marketing consulting, or agency environments.
  • Experience presenting recommendations and performance insights to clients or business stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of integrated digital marketing strategy and how multiple channels work together to drive business outcomes.
  • Demonstrated expertise in multiple digital marketing disciplines and working knowledge across paid, organic, content, local, email, and analytics channels.
  • Experience analyzing marketing performance data and translating insights into strategic recommendations.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Strong organizational, project management, and problem-solving abilities.

Preferred

  • Agency experience managing multiple client accounts.
  • Experience supporting multi-location, healthcare, multifamily, higher education, franchise, or B2B marketing programs.
  • Familiarity with GA4, Looker Studio, CRM platforms, marketing automation platforms, and reporting tools.
  • Understanding of AI-powered search experiences, AEO, attribution frameworks, and conversion optimization.

What Makes Someone Successful in This Role

  • You naturally connect business goals to marketing strategy.
  • You enjoy solving complex marketing challenges and uncovering growth opportunities.
  • You can confidently communicate with clients, executives, and channel specialists.
  • You think beyond individual tactics and understand how channels work together throughout the customer journey.
  • You are comfortable using data to inform decisions and recommendations.
  • You balance strategic thinking with accountability and execution.
  • You stay curious about emerging trends in AI, search, media, and digital marketing.

Why Join Ironmark

At Ironmark, we combine strategy, creativity, technology, and data to help organizations grow. Our team thrives on collaboration, innovation, continuous learning, and delivering measurable results for clients across a wide range of industries.

As a Senior Digital Marketing Strategist, you’ll have the opportunity to influence meaningful client outcomes, collaborate with talented specialists, and help shape the future of integrated digital marketing.

About Kinetic

At Kinetic, we’re redefining operational excellence in higher education, conferencing, and events. As the leading provider of software solutions for student accommodation, event management, catering, and residential services, we help institutions streamline operations, elevate customer experiences, and unlock their full potential.

With over 25 years of experience and trusted by more than 350 institutions worldwide, our software empowers universities and venues to run smarter, faster, and more collaboratively. From bustling campuses to dynamic corporate environments, our technology adapts to the rhythm of each organisation — helping them thrive in a fast-changing world.

But we’re more than just software. We’re a team of passionate problem-solvers, innovators, and collaborators who care deeply about our customers and each other. Our culture is built on empowerment, community, and continuous growth. We believe in giving people the tools, support, and freedom to do their best work — and have fun while doing it.

Joining Kinetic means being part of a purpose-driven business where your ideas matter, your development is supported, and your impact is real. If you’re ready to help shape the future of operational technology in education and events, we’d love to meet you.

About Wellspring

Wellspring Worldwide, Inc. is a leading provider of web-based software systems for managing research, technology commercialization, and innovation operations for universities, companies, government agencies, and independent labs. Founded in 2003, Wellspring has grown to serve over 500 organizations globally, including Fortune 500 companies, SMEs, hospitals, and universities. The company’s flagship products—Sophia, Flintbox, and Zeto—enable organizations to manage the entire innovation lifecycle, from discovery and IP management to commercialization and knowledge transfer.

We are seeking a highly skilled Corporate Counsel with 5-7 years of corporate experience to serve as the senior-most legal, compliance, and privacy authority at Wellspring Worldwide. This role combines the responsibilities of Corporate Counsel—owning the full spectrum of legal risk, regulatory compliance, and privacy across the company's global operations. In these roles you will partner with our CTO who is our Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) The ideal candidate will leverage AI-powered legal tools to drive efficiency and scalability, while advising executive leadership as a trusted strategic partner.

This role carries direct ownership of three functional areas:

  • Legal strategy, contracts, M&A, litigation, IP, corporate governance, and international expansion.
  • Regulatory compliance, internal controls, and security policy frameworks.
  • Personal data governance and global privacy compliance.

Key Responsibilities

Legal Compliance & Risk Management

  • Ensure the company's operations adhere to applicable international, national, and local laws and regulations.
  • Identify, analyze, and manage legal risks across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Establish and maintain policies and procedures to mitigate legal risks.
  • Use AI-powered compliance monitoring tools to track regulatory changes across jurisdictions in real time, reducing manual research burden.

ContractReview andManagement

  • Draft, review, and negotiate a wide range of contracts including commercial agreements, employment contracts, vendor agreements, and partnerships.
  • Manage cross-border transactions and contracts, ensuring compliance with international regulations.
  • Maintain AI-assisted contract templates and playbooks to standardize and streamline negotiation.

Corporate Governance

  • Advise on corporate governance best practices and ensure compliance with board governance frameworks.
  • Partner with the Finance team and the company’s registered agent to ensure compliance with all Secretary of State registrations and annual report filings.
  • Assist with board meetings, resolutions, and related legal documentation.

Regulatory Affairs Responsibilities

  • Monitoring changes in international laws and regulations and ensuring timely compliance across all operating jurisdictions.
  • Designing, implementing, and maintaining the company's internal controls framework, ensuring consistent adherence to policies and regulatory obligations.
  • Developing security-related policies and compliance frameworks, working in close partnership with IT/CISO on implementation and enforcement.
  • Managing relationships with regulators and handling any regulatory inquiries or investigations.
  • Leading compliance risk assessments and reporting to the executive team and board.
  • Leveraging AI-assisted regulatory intelligence platforms to proactively identify and assess the impact of regulatory changes on company operations.

Data Privacy Officer Responsibilities

  • Owning and maintaining the Company's personal data governance framework.
  • Ensuring full compliance with GDPR and all applicable global data protection laws (CCPA, UK GDPR, and other jurisdiction-specific regimes).

Litigation & Dispute Resolution

  • Oversee and manage litigation, arbitration, or disputes, coordinating with external counsel as needed.
  • Represent the company in negotiations and dispute resolution processes.
  • Use AI-powered e-discovery and document review tools to reduce cost and time in litigation support.

Intellectual Property

  • Safeguard the company's IP assets by managing global registrations, infringements, and disputes.
  • Use AI tools to monitor IP landscapes, identify potential infringement, and manage portfolio tracking at scale.

AI & Legal Technology Leadership

  • Champion legal and compliance technology adoption, evaluating and implementing AI tools across legal, compliance, and privacy functions.
  • Establish governance frameworks and usage policies for AI in legal workflows, ensuring accuracy, confidentiality, and ethical use.
  • Partner with technology and product teams to advise on AI-related legal risk, data privacy, and emerging regulatory requirements (e.g., EU AI Act, state AI laws).
  • Stay current on AI law, privacy regulation, and compliance developments and advise leadership on strategic implications.

Stakeholder Management & Training

  • Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership on legal, compliance, and privacy implications of strategic decisions.
  • Collaborate with external counsel and advisors for specialized legal matters.
  • Provide training to internal teams on commercial contracts, compliance, data privacy, contract management, and responsible use of AI legal tools.

Qualifications

  • JD, LLB, or equivalent degree from an ABA-approved law school.
  • Licensed to practice law in at least one U.S. jurisdiction; multi-jurisdictional licensure preferred.
  • 5-7 years of experience in a similar role with international exposure in a multinational corporation or law firm.
  • Demonstrated experience serving in or alongside a Data Privacy Officer function, with hands-on GDPR compliance ownership.
  • Proven experience managing internal controls frameworks and regulatory compliance programs (CCO-equivalent experience).
  • Strong knowledge of international business law, regulations, and best practices.
  • Exceptional negotiation, drafting, and communication skills.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills; ability to manage external counsel and legal budgets.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in SaaS, tech transfer, or adjacent technology industries.
  • Hands-on experience evaluating, procuring, or implementing legal technology or AI tools.

raw.description:
About Allia Health Group

Allia Health Group (AHG) is building a vertically integrated digital health platform — connecting compounding pharmacy, women's and men's telehealth, a provider-facing electronic health record, and an AI-and-data infrastructure layer into a single, coordinated patient experience. Our portfolio spans a 503A compounding pharmacy, two direct-to-consumer telehealth brands, and a provider-network EHR launching in 2026, all sharing a common goal: deliver personalized, outcomes-driven care beyond the limits of the traditional healthcare model.

We are assembling a senior leadership team to scale that platform. We are looking for a Chief Product Officer to define and lead the product strategy that turns a collection of strong businesses into one connected, durable healthcare system.

The Opportunity

This is AHG's first dedicated product executive. You will build and lead the product discipline across the company: what we build, for whom, why, and in what order — across every brand and surface. That means consumer direct-to-consumer subscription products in women's and men's telehealth, a provider-facing electronic health record launching this year, a clinical layer on top of a compounding pharmacy, and the shared patient platform that connects them. It is a deliberately broad mandate, and the breadth is the point.

The role is defined by a clear division of decision rights with our Chief Technology Officer.The CTO owns supply— architecture, engineering, data infrastructure, security, reliability, and delivery.The CPO owns demand— the user problems worth solving, the product strategy, the roadmap and its priority order, the discovery work that validates what gets built, and the outcomes the product is accountable for. The two roles are peers at the executive table, reporting to the CEO. Neither stacks under the other.

If you are the kind of product leader who is energized by building a function from the ground up — installing discovery, design, and product analytics as disciplines, growing a high-potential product team, and being personally accountable for whether real patients and providers actually use and value what we ship — this is a rare mandate.

AI is central to this role, not adjacent to it.Our CTO is investing heavily in AHG's AI and data platform — models, ML pipelines, automation, and safety infrastructure. We are looking for a CPO who is the demand-side counterpart to that investment: an AI-native product leader who decides which AI capabilities become real products for patients and clinicians, designs them to earn trust, and runs the product organization itself with AI woven into how the team discovers, prototypes, researches, and measures. You will not be selling AI to a skeptical company — you will be partnering with a technology org that is already all-in, and giving that capability a product and a purpose.

How the Role Works

AHG operates as a multi-entity platform.Each business unit is led by its own CEO who owns that unit's P&L. The CPO leads the product function as a shared, enterprise-wide capability that every business consumes — setting product standards, methods, and talent for the whole company, while owning end-to-end product for the shared patient platform and the new provider EHR directly.

  • Direct ownership:the shared cross-brand patient platform, the provider-network EHR product, the company's product discovery / design / research / analytics disciplines, and the product talent function.
  • Partnership ownership:business-unit roadmaps are set in close partnership with each BU's leadership. You are the executive who brings product rigor, evidence, and prioritization to those conversations — and the executive BU leaders escalate product and UX problems to.
  • Influence over authority:you will succeed here by being the most trusted voice on what's worth building, not by command. The mandate is real, but it is earned through evidence, outcomes, and partnership.
  • Stays with the CTO (not this role):the data warehouse and business intelligence, cloud and platform architecture, security and SOC 2, ERP and infrastructure vendors, engineering delivery, and the AI/ML platform and its safety infrastructure. The CPO sets the demand on these systems — what they must enable and why — while the CTO owns how they are built and run.

Key Responsibilities

Product strategy & portfolio prioritization

  • Own a product strategy for each business and for the portfolio — a distinct artifact from the technology roadmap that states, for each area: the user problem, the hypothesis, the outcome we are trying to move, and what we are deliberately not doing.
  • Prioritize across the portfolio through a product lens, not a bandwidth lens — deciding how finite product and engineering capacity is allocated across competing opportunities based on value, not on who asks loudest.
  • Champion a “connected system over isolated products” approach: a unified patient identity and experience across brands, rather than four disconnected silos.

Product discovery & evidence

  • Install product discovery as a standard: continuous customer and provider interviews, prototype and usability testing, and validated problem definition before significant build begins.
  • Require that major initiatives carry discovery artifacts — interview findings, an explicit hypothesis, and the metric that will tell us we were right or wrong — and make those artifacts drive what gets prioritized.

Design, user research & quality

  • Build the product design, user research, and design-system disciplines AHG needs — accessibility standards, interaction patterns, and a consistent quality bar across every brand and the EHR.
  • Be the executive accountable for whether the product is genuinely usable by the humans who use it — patients, providers, and pharmacists — and the advocate for the user when speed and shipping pressure compete with quality.

Outcomes & product analytics

  • Own outcome metrics, not output metrics: subscription retention and activation in the consumer telehealth brands, provider activation and retention on the EHR, medication adherence in the pharmacy programs, and patient experience (e.g., NPS) across the platform.
  • Stand up product analytics as a discipline distinct from business intelligence — event-level instrumentation, cohort and funnel analysis, and experimentation that lets a product manager find a drop-off and ship a fix against it.

Healthcare product leadership

  • EHR / provider experience:ensure the provider workflow is mapped, observed, and prototyped before production screens are built; reducing clinician cognitive burden is the single biggest determinant of adoption. Own the provider activation funnel end to end.
  • Clinical AI as product:set strategy for AI features that touch patients and clinicians — including an ambient documentation / scribing strategy for the EHR — partnering with the CTO, who owns the AI platform and safety infrastructure. You decide what AI ships to users and hold the line when something isn't ready, even if it is technically deployable.
  • Chronic-care platform layer:design the clinical-engagement layer (adherence, side-effect management, dose support) that turns medication fulfillment into a durable chronic-disease management experience.
  • Platform & interoperability:own the strategic product decision of whether AHG becomes one connected, multi-brand patient experience or stays a set of separate products — and ensure the shared platform and EHR are designed API-first, with a standards-based (HL7 / FHIR) encounter layer open enough to integrate external pharmacy, lab, imaging, and ambient-AI services rather than a closed system.
  • Regulated by design:partner with Compliance and Clinical so that product decisions respect HIPAA, telehealth, FDA, and clinical-safety requirements from the start, not as an afterthought.

An AI-first product organization

  • AI in the product:treat AI as a core design surface, not a bolt-on feature — set the strategy for the AI capabilities that touch patients and providers (triage and coaching assistants, ambient documentation, adherence and follow-up agents, decision support), partnering with the CTO who owns the underlying AI/ML platform and safety infrastructure.
  • Agentic AI with proportionate oversight:match the level of human oversight to the cost of a mistake — autonomous with audit logging for low-stakes, high-volume tasks; human-in-the-loop for medium-stakes; mandatory clinician review and accountability for anything liability-bearing. You decide what AI ships to users and hold the line when something isn't ready, even if it is technically deployable.
  • An AI-native team:run the product function itself with AI built into how the team works — AI-assisted user-research synthesis, rapid prototyping, competitive and market analysis, PRD and spec drafting, and product-analytics querying — so a small product team operates with outsized leverage. We want a leader who raises the bar on what AI-augmented product work looks like and hires people who think the same way.
  • Trustworthy by design:ensure AI features show their reasoning, expose confidence, and always leave a clear human override — in regulated healthcare this is a trust and liability standard, not a preference.

Team & cross-functional leadership

  • Build the product organization — hiring, leveling, and career paths for product managers, designers, and researchers, and developing existing high-potential product talent into senior leaders.
  • Partner deeply with the CTO and engineering to co-own delivery of the core platform, data products, and AI-enabled systems — product owns what and why; engineering owns how.
  • Serve as the bridge between the executive team and the product organization, translating company strategy into a roadmap and reporting on outcomes at the board level.

What Success Looks Like (First 12 Months)

  • A documented product strategy exists for each business and the portfolio, distinct from the tech roadmap, and is driving prioritization decisions.
  • Discovery, design, user research, and product analytics exist as functioning disciplines — with the right early hires in place — not as ad-hoc activities.
  • The provider EHR has a mapped clinical workflow, a decided ambient-AI strategy, and a measured provider activation funnel before — or at — launch.
  • Outcome metrics (retention, provider activation, adherence, NPS) are instrumented, visible to leadership, and owned by Product.
  • Business-unit leaders treat the CPO as the trusted partner they negotiate roadmap with and escalate product problems to.

Ideal Candidate Profile

Experience

  • 12+ years in product, with 5+ years in an executive product role (CPO, SVP/VP of Product, or equivalent) at a digital health, healthtech, regulated-SaaS, or enterprise-technology company.
  • A track record of building and scaling multi-product or platform-based ecosystems — not managing a single product line.
  • Direct experience in a regulated environment (healthcare strongly preferred; fintech or similarly regulated industries considered), including HIPAA, telehealth, FDA, or clinical-safety contexts.
  • Range across both of AHG's product worlds: consumer DTC subscription product (acquisition, activation, retention economics) AND provider- or clinical-facing product (clinical workflow, provider adoption). Deep expertise in one is required; credible, demonstrated range into the other is essential — this role cannot be filled by a single-surface specialist.
  • A proven partnership with a CTO/engineering leadership to bring complex products to market, with a clear, healthy demand-vs-supply working model.
  • Experience standing up product discovery, design, user research, and product analytics as disciplines — having built the function, not just inherited it.
  • Demonstrated experience shipping AI-powered product features — ideally including LLM and agentic-AI use cases — with a clear point of view on oversight, safety, and trust in a high-stakes or regulated setting.

Skills & attributes

  • A strategic thinker who turns vision into evidence-based, prioritized roadmaps — and who says “no” well.
  • Deep product-led-growth and outcomes orientation; fluent in retention, activation, cohort, and funnel analysis.
  • A builder's instinct for design and user research quality, with the judgment to hold a quality bar under shipping pressure.
  • An influence-first operator comfortable leading a shared function across autonomous business units without relying on positional authority.
  • AI-native in how you work and lead — you use AI tools fluently across discovery, prototyping, research, and analysis, and you expect your team to; you are energized, not threatened, by a technology org going all-in on AI.
  • Strong business and commercial acumen — able to tie product investment to revenue, margin, and enterprise value, and to make that case to the board.
  • Excellent communication and executive presence; calm and clarifying in ambiguity and high growth.

Why Join AHG

  • Found the function.You will be AHG's first product executive, with the mandate to define how product is done across the company.
  • Real stakes, real users.Your work directly shapes patient and provider outcomes across pharmacy, telehealth, and a new EHR.
  • A clear seat.A defined demand-vs-supply partnership with a strong CTO, and a direct line to the CEO and board.
  • AI-forward, with a real platform behind it.Partner with a technology organization investing heavily in AI and data infrastructure — and own the product side of turning that capability into things patients and clinicians actually trust and use.
  • Platform-level impact.Decide whether AHG becomes one connected patient experience or stays four silos — one of the most consequential product calls in the company's next five years.

Allia Health Group is an equal-opportunity employer. We evaluate all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

raw.description:
What is Equisoft? Equisoft is a global provider of digital solutions for insurance and investments, recognized by more than 300 of the world’s leading financial institutions. We offer a comprehensive ecosystem of scalable solutions that help our customers navigate the challenges of digital transformation – powered by a business needs-driven approach, deep industry knowledge, cutting-edge technologies, and multicultural team of experts based in North America, the Caribbean, Latin America, Europe, Africa, Asia, and Australia.

Why Choose Equisoft? With 950+ employees, we are a stable organization that offers career advancement and fosters a stimulant environment. If that’s not enough, then check out these other perks below:

  • Hiring Location: USA (Philadelphia)

  • You are welcome to work at the office, hybrid or remote. 

  • Internal job title: VP, Wealth and Insurance Solutions - USA

  • Full-time Permanent Role

  • Benefits available, 1st of the month following date of hire: Medical, Dental, Telemedicine Program, etc. Quarterly Enrollment for Retirement Funds

  • Flexible hours

  • Number of hours per week: 40

  • Educational Support (LinkedIn Learning, LOMA Courses and Equisoft University)

Role: The VP, Wealth and Insurance Solutions - USA reports to the CSO (Chief Sales Officer). The incumbent is Equisoft's Insurance engine in the region. This is a consultative enterprise sales role with a pure hunter mandate: you identify, pursue, and close net-new Annual Recurring Revenue with Life and Annuity carriers across the USA.

Equisoft is shifting from a services focused company to a software company as we continue to build out or own intellectual property and solutions.

Pas-less transformation is geared towards companies who don’t want to replace their core - Equisoft has developed new software to enable modernizing without necessarily changing the core. In addition, Equisoft continues to invest in our own Intellectual property and software solutions to help accelerate the shift from a services focused company to an ARR focused company.

You are an individual contributor with a direct quota focused on new ARR each year. You own the deal from first contact to close. You build your own pipeline. You run your own account strategies. You coordinate Equisoft's pre-sales, inside sales and the USA regional team in your sales pursuits — but the customer relationship, the deal strategy, and the close are yours. You will be supported by the Chief Sales Officer and a Deal Governance committee.,

The ideal candidate brings the credibility of someone who has sold into Life and Annuity carriers at the C-suite level, a genuine personal network in the USA insurance technology market, and the consultative depth to articulate the business and IT transformation case for core systems modernization. You understand how a carrier's CIO, CTO, Chief Actuary, and Chief Transformation Officer think — and you can speak each of their languages to demonstrate the value that Equisoft can bring to their organization.

You will work closely with Equisoft's primary alliance partner Oracle and leverage new partners, develop channel relationships to generate joint pipeline and co-sell into carrier accounts. You bring experience working with system integrators and strategic partners as deal accelerators, not just for implementation — but as pipeline sources and deal influencers.

Your Day with Equisoft:

Pipeline Generation & New Business Development

  • Proactively build, qualify, and manage a pipeline of net-new Life & Annuity carrier opportunities across the USA named accounts

  • Deploy structured strategies for securing new insurance carrier accounts — combining personal network outreach, alliance channel activation, supported by targeted event marketing and inside sales

  • Leverage Equisoft's Oracle partner relationships to source introductions, co-sell referrals, and joint pipeline across the territory

  • Represent Equisoft at USA insurance industry events, carrier forums, analyst briefings, and technology conferences to build brand awareness and generate qualified opportunities

  • Identify, engage, and cultivate relationships with system integrators, consultancies, and advisory firms operating in the USA market as additional pipeline channels

Sales Execution — Full Cycle Ownership

  • Lead the complete enterprise sales cycle from prospecting through commercial close: initial contact, discovery, solution positioning, business case development, proposal, negotiation, and contract execution

  • Build carrier-specific value propositions grounded in client business outcomes — connecting Equisoft's capabilities to the transformation objectives of the CIO, CTO, Chief Actuary, and Chief Transformation Officer

  • Navigate and coordinate multi-stakeholder buying committees within large carrier organizations — building relationships at all levels from operational champions to Board-level sponsors

  • Lead and optimize responses to RFP/RFI processes with commercial rigour, carrier-specific relevance, and clear differentiation versus competitors while being supported by the Pre-Sales team

  • Coordinate internal resources — pre-sales solution engineering, professional services, product, legal, and executive sponsors — to build compelling, deliverable, and commercially sound proposals

  • Manage Proof of Concept (POC) engagements with Equisoft's pre-sales team, maintaining deal momentum and progressing toward technical and commercial close

  • Negotiate commercial terms, pricing structures, and contractual frameworks in partnership with Equisoft's legal and finance teams, supported by the Chief Sales Officer

  • Schedule, arrange, and participate in technical and functional presentations to insurance carrier prospects alongside Equisoft's solution consulting and engineering team

Alliance & Partner Management

  • Build and maintain active local working relationships with the Oracle Prime and Co-prime partner representatives across the USA named accounts — attending partner events, maintaining regular cadence, and tracking joint pipeline

  • Co-develop joint go-to-market activities, co-selling motions, and partner-influenced deal strategies with Oracle and our other alliance partners within the USA named accounts

  • Identify and develop relationships with regional system integrators (SIs) and consultancies that can accelerate carrier modernization deals and provide pipeline referrals

  • Serve as Equisoft's primary relationship holder with regional alliance and SI contacts, supported by the USA Region Head and the Chief Sales Officer

Customer Relationship Management & Post-Sale

  • Maintain strong relationships with insurance carrier accounts post-close, working alongside Equisoft's Account Manager team in USA to help ensure Customer Success and successful project delivery from the Professional Services teams

  • Transition the customer relationship over to the Account Management team, post-sales and support the Account Manager as they seek to identify expansion ARR opportunities within the account — new modules, additional lines, or subsidiary accounts

  • Maintain accurate, current, and complete records of all pipeline activity, account interactions, and deal progression in HubSpot CRM — pipeline accuracy is a condition of plan participation

Market Intelligence & Internal Contribution

  • Maintain deep, current awareness of the USA competitive landscape — providing structured competitive intelligence to Product and Marketing

  • Analyze market trends, regulatory developments (Solvency II, IFRS 17, local market dynamics), and carrier strategic priorities to identify new opportunity areas

  • Present regular pipeline and activity reports to the CSO; contribute regional market perspective to Equisoft's global USA expansion planning

  • Support analyst and advisor briefings as Equisoft's USA market presence grows

  • Participate in weekly team stand up meetings outlining the coming week’s activities.

  • Participate in bi-weekly sales team forecast calls with particular emphasis on the Committed and Upside deals for the current fiscal year

Requirements:

Technical

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and enterprise sales experience

  • +10 years of enterprise software (SaaS) sales experience in a hunter/new logo capacity

  • Ideally proven, verifiable track record selling digital and core Life & Annuity insurance technology (asset)

  • Deep understanding of L&A product lines, carrier operating models, actuarial and regulatory frameworks (Solvency II, IFRS 17), and technology modernization priorities specific to USA markets

  • Established personal network (a real rolodex) within Life & Annuity carrier C-suites across the UK and at least one other USA market — CIO, CTO, Chief Actuary, Chief Transformation Officer, CFO

  • Demonstrated experience selling alongside or through Oracle, Guidewire, or major SI partners (Capgemini, Deloitte, Accenture, TCS, etc.) in an USA context

  • Proven ability to close complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals with 12–24+ month sales cycles and contract values of $1M+ ARR

  • Experience working with or at Life & Annuity insurers, or in a consulting role serving L&A carriers (asset)

  • Ability to travel to events or client’s locations all over USA named accounts

  • Excellent knowledge of English (spoken and written)

Soft skills

  • Exceptional consultative selling skills — you sell business outcomes and transformation value, not product features

  • Strong value-selling ability: you can connect a carrier's strategic transformation objectives to Equisoft’s solutions and build a compelling business case at executive level

  • Executive presence and credibility — polished, precise, and authoritative in C-suite and Board-level conversations at major carrier organizations

  • Highly proactive, persistent hunter mindset — you build your own pipeline, you do not wait for marketing leads, and you are comfortable navigating complex organizational barriers within large insurers

  • Strong analytical skills: ability to evaluate market trends, identify new opportunity areas, and build data-informed account strategies

  • Proficiency with HubSpot CRM or equivalent enterprise CRM; forecast accuracy and pipeline discipline are expected

  • Ability to work autonomously and effectively in a scaling, entrepreneurial environment where you will be shaping the playbook, not inheriting one

Equisoft is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

Selection process developed by matteria

Location and Work Mode

Remote (Preferably based in Latin America).

Who we are

We partner with mission-driven organizations and high-growth ventures to build leadership teams that move the world forward. Our approach blends rigorous executive search, data-informed market mapping, and a human, long-term relationship with both clients and candidates.

We’ve delivered 1,900+ placements across 15 countries (Latin America, North America, and Europe), worked with 600+ organizations across the private, public, and civil sectors, and host a talent platform with 90,000+ registered users. This scale helps us run sharper searches, faster, with a consistently excellent candidate experience.

Our impact

  • 1,900+ executive and leadership placements completed.

  • Active across 15 countries in Latin America, North America, and Europe.

  • Trusted by 600+ organizations across the private, public, and social sectors.

  • Community of 90,000+ professionals within our talent platform.

Purpose of the Position

The Senior Talent Consultant at matteria leads executive searches end to end, partnering with leaders who are changing the world, wherever they happen to be building. This person brings both the technical execution of headhunting and a strategic, consultative lens, listening closely to translate a client's ambitions into winning candidate profiles, and becomes the client's senior point of contact, able to navigate complex conversations fluently in English.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Client Advisory

  • Lead executive discovery sessions to deeply understand organizational challenges and leadership needs.

  • Translate loosely defined client expectations into structured search strategies and compelling leadership profiles.

  • Serve as the senior strategic point of contact throughout every engagement.

  • Facilitate executive-level conversations and decision-making in English with confidence and independence.

Executive Search Leadership

  • Own the full executive search lifecycle, including intake meetings, role definition, compensation calibration, sourcing strategy, executive outreach, candidate assessment, client presentations, offer management, and successful placement.

  • Design tailored search strategies for leadership positions across multiple industries and geographies.

  • Conduct sophisticated market mapping and direct headhunting of passive executive talent.

Leadership Assessment & Consulting

  • Conduct structured executive interviews and leadership assessments.

  • Evaluate candidates based on competencies, leadership capabilities, cultural alignment, and mission fit.

  • Advise clients on market dynamics, candidate trade-offs, and hiring decisions with sound judgment and objectivity.

Candidate Experience

  • Deliver an exceptional candidate experience through transparent communication, timely feedback, and respectful engagement.

  • Lead executive negotiations and support successful onboarding and post-placement follow-up.

Market Intelligence & Operational Excellence

  • Produce executive search reports, market intelligence, compensation insights, and pipeline analytics.

  • Continuously leverage technology and AI tools to strengthen research, sourcing, documentation, and decision-making.

  • Contribute to internal knowledge sharing, methodology improvements, and mentoring of junior consultants when appropriate.

Requirements and competences to work with us

Education

  • We prioritize proven capability over credentials. No specific degree required.

  • What matters: a track record delivering end-to-end executive searches, sharp judgment, and consistent results.

  • Advanced studies or certifications (e.g., executive coaching, org psychology, OD, analytics) are welcome but optional if your experience speaks for itself.

Experience

  • 7–12+ years in executive search, senior recruiting, or leadership hiring—agency or in-house—delivering Director/C-Suite or hard-to-fill leadership roles.

  • Proven track record of direct headhunting and closing passive candidates across multiple markets/time zones.

  • Comfortable running multiple searches concurrently in a freelance/independent setup with clear SLAs and outcome accountability.

Knowledge and Skills

  • Professional, fluent, bilingual English, able to lead client calls, negotiations, and written deliverables independently, with no translation support required; additional languages such as Spanish or Portuguese are an asset.

  • Expertise in leadership assessment, behavioral interviewing, and talent mapping.

  • Outstanding project management and organizational abilities.

  • Fluency with technology and AI tools as a core part of how you work, not an afterthought, using them to accelerate research, sourcing, and decision-making.

  • Proficiency in digital recruitment platforms, applicant tracking systems (ATS), and professional networking tools.

  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

Competencies

  • Ownership & speed: bias to action, proactive risk mitigation, reliable on-time delivery.

  • Judgment: sharp evaluation of leadership competencies and cultural/mission fit.

  • Consultative seniority: the instinct to ask the right questions, truly listen, and translate loosely defined client needs into concrete, actionable deliverables.

  • Global mindset: comfort working across cultures, languages, and sectors; high adaptability.

  • Integrity & empathy: candidate-first approach with uncompromising ethics and confidentiality.

  • Learning agility: iterate on playbooks, test new channels, and share best practices.

Our team profile

At matteria, Executive Search is fundamentally a people business. We believe outstanding results come from combining technical excellence with empathy, curiosity, ownership, and continuous improvement.

Our culture is built around ten guiding principles:

  • We Connect with People: curiosity, empathy, and meaningful opportunities.

  • We Solve for the Client: their impact is our impact; we exceed expectations.

  • We Are World-Class: rigorous preparation, professional presence, never late.

  • Responsible Autonomy: freedom with sound judgment; ownership and speed.

  • We Solve with Data: evidence over opinion; reduce bias, decide better.

  • We Take Care of EVERY Detail: impeccable deliverables; craft matters.

  • Immediate Feedback: candid, caring, and frequent—growth is a team sport.

  • Curiosity: learn daily, research proactively, elevate collective knowledge.

  • AI Collaborates with Us: tech amplifies our creativity and execution.

  • We Love to Laugh: humility and humor as resilience and connection.

Key interests for working with us

This role is designed for someone who wants to become a trusted advisor to organizations creating meaningful change around the world, not simply someone who fills executive positions.

Our team is inspired by organizations addressing challenges such as:

  • Climate action

  • Sustainable development

  • Education

  • Healthcare

  • Economic inclusion

  • Entrepreneurship

  • Social innovation

  • Technology for good

  • Institutional strengthening

  • Purpose-driven business

We believe leadership changes organizations, and organizations change the world.

Reasons to join our team

  • Partner directly with founders, CEOs, Boards, and leadership teams driving meaningful impact.

  • Lead sophisticated international executive searches with significant autonomy.

  • Build a long-term consulting career with one of Latin America's leading executive search firms focused on impact organizations.

  • Learn advanced executive search methodologies, leadership assessment frameworks, and AI-powered recruiting practices.

  • Join a collaborative culture that values excellence, ownership, curiosity, and continuous improvement.

  • Enjoy the flexibility of a fully remote work environment.

  • Benefit from a performance-based compensation model with strong earning potential.

Relevant details before applying for this vacancy

  • Fully remote position.

  • Preferred location: Latin America.

  • Independent Contractor / Freelance engagement.

  • Project-based work with clearly defined deliverables and service agreements.

  • Expected capacity to manage 2–4 executive search assignments simultaneously.

  • Professional bilingual English is mandatory.

  • Spanish is required; Portuguese is highly valued.

  • Availability to collaborate across AMER and partial EMEA time zones.

About Our Client

Our client is a fast-growing lead generation and digital marketing company that helps businesses accelerate revenue by delivering exclusive, high-quality sales opportunities. After establishing themselves as a trusted partner to real estate investors nationwide, they are expanding into the roofing industry by providing qualified homeowner leads through a flexible pay-per-lead model. Their mission is simple: help contractors grow their businesses by connecting them with customers actively looking for their services.

Job Summary

We're seeking a highly motivated, results-driven Inside Sales Representative with experience in Real Estate Investing (REI) and/or the Roofing industry. This is a fully outbound, high-volume cold-calling role where you'll be responsible for prospecting, developing relationships, presenting our client's lead generation services, overcoming objections, negotiating, and closing new business.

You'll manage the full sales cycle from initial cold call through close, selling qualified leads to real estate investment and roofing companies nationwide.

The ideal candidate is competitive, resilient, confident on the phone, and understands the challenges and needs of REI and/or roofing businesses. If you're an experienced salesperson who enjoys the hunt and wants uncapped earning potential, this is an outstanding opportunity.

What We Offer

  • Base salary: $30,000 - $40,000 annually

  • On-Target Earnings (OTE): $100,000 - $120,000

  • Uncapped commission with six-figure earning potential

  • Commission begins once your annual base salary has been recouped through sales

  • Earn 7% commission on all revenue generated after reaching your base threshold

  • Example: Sell $20,000 in lead packages and earn $1,400 in commission

  • Lowest-performing sales representatives typically earn $90,000+ annually

  • Top-performing sales representatives earn $200,000+ in total compensation

  • Comprehensive paid training and onboarding

  • Employer-paid Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Fully remote position with long-term growth opportunities

Qualifications

  • 2+ years of sales experience, preferably selling into the REI and/or roofing industry

  • Proven success making high-volume outbound cold calls

  • Demonstrated ability to manage the full sales cycle from prospecting through close

  • Strong closing skills with confidence handling objections and asking for the sale

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, performance-driven sales environment

  • CRM experience required; Go High Level (GoHighLevel) experience is strongly preferred

  • Highly self-motivated with strong organizational and time management skills

  • Ability to work independently while consistently meeting activity and sales goals

  • Working laptop or desktop computer with reliable high-speed internet connection

  • Positive attitude, coachable mindset, and desire to continuously improve

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Conduct high-volume outbound cold calls to roofing companies and real estate investment companies nationwide

  • Prospect, qualify, and develop new business opportunities through outbound calling

  • Sell pay-per-lead marketing services using a consultative sales approach

  • Manage the entire sales cycle, from initial prospecting and discovery through presentation, negotiation, and close

  • Build rapport quickly and identify each prospect's lead generation needs and business objectives

  • Clearly communicate the value of qualified leads and how the service can help prospects grow their businesses

  • Consistently overcome objections and negotiate win-win solutions

  • Ask for the sale and close new accounts

  • Manage and maintain an organized sales pipeline within the CRM

  • Utilize Go High Level (GoHighLevel) to track activities, manage follow-ups, and nurture prospects

  • Follow up consistently with prospects and opportunities throughout the sales cycle

  • Meet and exceed daily activity metrics, weekly sales goals, and monthly revenue targets

  • Collaborate with leadership to improve sales strategies and customer experience

  • Maintain accurate notes, reporting, and pipeline management while representing the company professionally in every interaction

raw.description:
Workers' Compensation Attorney

Career Consulting Partners has partnered with a growing workers' compensation defense law firm. They are building the firm of the future with an employee-centric model. The founding partners come from large WC defense firms, and we seek to create something more modern and collegial. Our model is designed for low-volume cases, allowing our experienced attorneys to achieve the best results for our clients.

This is a full-time Remote Attorney role with no obligation to work in the office. All at-home office equipment will be provided. However, the attorney is required to travel for in-person appearances such as depositions, walkthroughs, expedited hearings, and trials. The Associate Attorney will be responsible for handling workers’ compensation defense cases throughout Southern California. We have a competitive compensation package and offer full benefits. We offer one of the industry's leading bonus structures for our employees.

Responsibilities:

  • Handle a caseload of workers' compensation defense cases for various clients with a very active support staff (2:1 assignment ratio)

  • Manage a caseload of workers' compensation defense cases with dedicated support staff.

  • Conduct legal research and develop defense strategies.

  • Represent employers, insurers, and third-party administrators in hearings, trials, and appeals.

  • Draft pleadings, motions, and settlement agreements.

  • Assess claims, advise clients on exposure and liability, and negotiate settlements.

  • Ensure compliance with workers' compensation laws and stay updated on legal changes.

  • Participate in mediation and dispute resolution.

  • Collaborate with attorneys and support staff while maintaining strong client relationships.

Qualifications:

  • Strong knowledge of California Worker's Compensation law

  • 2 - 10 years of experience in workers' compensation defense litigation

  • Ability to work independently and remotely

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

  • Admission in good standing to the State Bar of California

  • Experience taking an applicant's deposition and taking/defending a doctor’s deposition

  • Experience appearing for all WC hearings (status conference, priority conference, MSC, and lien conference).

  • We do not require that the candidate have taken a case through trial; we are looking for a candidate who has prepared a case for appearance at trial. We understand that a majority of the time, cases are settled before or on the day of trial.

Compensation & Benefits:

  • Base Compensation: $110,000 - $215,000 + Additional Bonuses (D.O.E.)

  • Bonuses are paid out quarterly

  • The most expansive and diverse compensation structure of any WC defense firm

  • Medical Insurance

  • Vision Insurance

  • Dental Insurance

  • 401(k) with up to 4% match

  • Commuter benefits

Location:

  • Fully Remote

  • Must reside in California

  • Admission in good standing to the State Bar of California

Please note that we at Career Consulting Partners will be sure to keep your information private. We will not submit you or your information to any firm without your consent. Once we have received your resume/application we will reach out to you and review the firm(s) before we move forward

Duties & Responsibilities

Prospecting and Lead Generation

  • Researching and identifying potential customers through various channels such as online research, social media, industry events, and networking.

Qualification and Initial Engagement

Relationship Building

  • Nurturing leads over time by providing relevant information, insights, and resources to educate and engage prospects.

Consultative Selling

Collaboration and Communication

Pipeline Management and Reporting

  • Generating regular reports and metrics to track performance against key performance indicators (KPIs) such as lead conversion rates, pipeline velocity, and revenue targets.

Continuous Learning and Development

  • Staying updated on industry trends, market dynamics, and competitive landscape to identify new opportunities and refine sales strategies.
  • Participating in training programs, workshops, and professional development activities to enhance selling skills and product knowledge.

Sales Strategy & Planning

  • Provide a value proposition primarily for AESSEAL products and services in all industrial sectors.
  • Cross selling AES Engineering Group products such as AVT Reliability products leveraging not limited to environmental protection, corporate sustainability, and ethical leadership, in alignment with world class asset reliability product and service delivery.
  • Adheres to the highest standards of integrity & leadership adopting AESSEAL Mission, Values and Vision.
  • Have a passion for developing strategic business, new customers, leveraging extensive technical, sales, commercial and negotiating experience.
  • Manages territory plans, sales pipeline activities, accounts, opportunities, and business reviews, that ensures AES Sales/Technical Team are aligned and motivated within group strategies at local levels.
  • Preparation and execution of specific territory sales plans, events, and marketing campaigns, measuring and reporting territory performance to line manager to continually develop our value offering and measure progress.

Commercial and Financial

  • Provide regular customer updates ensuring return on investment, AESSEAL value is always established.
  • Sale of products or services are in line with AESSEAL pricing and margin policies.
  • Ensure all contracts and transactions are in line with AES Global Terms and Conditions. Conduct regular customer contract reviews, measuring performance to defines rules and targets.
  • Ensure all quotations, orders, invoicing, and payments are managed and measured professionally.

Industry – Market Knowledge

  • Research, analyse industry trends and competitor activity to identify threats and opportunities.
  • Excellent engagement of all industry, social media, marketing, and market sector networking platforms, optimising new technology, digital marketing and digital branding concepts.
  • Membership of Industry Societies advantageous

raw.description:
About Client

Our client is a rapidly growing, data-driven company that provides high-quality, motivated seller leads to real estate investors and is expanding into the home services market. The company has played a role in a significant portion of off-market home sales over the past year and operates with a fast-paced, low-bureaucracy culture where results matter. Their customers are running real businesses on the leads they receive, so when an issue comes up, the goal isn't simply to respond — it's to understand the problem, solve it quickly, and build a relationship that keeps the customer successful.

Job Summary

We're looking for a Retention Specialist who can step in when an important customer is at risk of leaving and turn the situation around. You'll work directly with high-value and high-risk accounts, understand what's driving their concerns, and create practical plans to resolve the issues and earn their continued business. You'll also help Customer Success Managers become better at identifying and addressing problems before they turn into cancellations. This is a highly visible role where you'll have a direct impact on customer satisfaction, retention, and recurring revenue — with the opportunity to turn what you learn from customers into better processes, playbooks, and company-wide improvements.

What We Offer

  • Base Salary: $70k - $90k

  • Performance Bonus, On-Target Earnings (OTE): $120k - $150k

  • Comprehensive paid training and onboarding

  • Employer-paid Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Fully remote position with long-term growth opportunities

  • Performance bonuses tied to customer retention, revenue protection, account expansion, and customer satisfaction

  • Opportunity to make a direct impact on company growth and recurring revenue

  • Work alongside a collaborative, high-performing leadership team

  • Career advancement opportunities within a rapidly growing organization

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Own retention efforts for high-risk and high-value customer accounts, using account health, usage, support history, payment activity, and customer feedback to identify and prioritize risk.

  • Proactively reach out to customers showing signs of dissatisfaction or potential cancellation before the relationship is lost.

  • Develop account-specific retention plans that clearly outline the problem, required actions, responsible parties, and follow-up timeline.

  • Act as the primary escalation point for complex, sensitive, or high-value cancellation situations.

  • De-escalate challenging customer conversations while maintaining a consultative, solutions-focused approach.

  • Work cross-functionally with Operations, Product, Billing, Sales, and Customer Success to identify and resolve the underlying causes of customer issues.

  • Document retention conversations, action plans, outcomes, and customer feedback accurately in the CRM.

  • Coach Customer Success Managers on handling early-stage churn risk, including objection handling, discovery, and knowing when an issue requires escalation.

  • Identify recurring reasons for cancellations and turn those insights into retention playbooks, SOPs, and improvements to the customer experience.

  • Identify expansion opportunities within retained accounts once the customer's core concerns have been fully addressed and the relationship is healthy.

Qualifications

  • 3–5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Retention, or another B2B customer-facing role.

  • Proven ability to successfully retain customers who are considering canceling or leaving.

  • Strong de-escalation, negotiation, and consultative communication skills.

  • Comfortable having difficult conversations and addressing customer concerns directly and professionally.

  • Experience coaching, mentoring, or training customer-facing team members.

  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to identify root causes rather than simply address symptoms.

  • Comfortable working in a CRM and using customer/account data to determine priorities and build action plans.

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple high-priority accounts and follow-ups simultaneously.

  • Experience building or improving playbooks, SOPs, workflows, or customer-facing processes is a plus.

  • Experience with subscription/SaaS, lead generation, real estate investors, small-business customers, or familiarity with churn and NRR metrics is a plus.
