raw.description:
Processo de seleção desenvolvido pela matteria

Localização e modo de trabalho

Residência fixa em uma das capitais da Amazônia Legal brasileira - Remoto

Quem somos

A missão da The Nature Conservancy (TNC) é proteger as terras e as águas das quais toda a vida depende. Como uma organização baseada na ciência, criamos soluções inovadoras e práticas para os desafios mais difíceis do mundo, para que possamos criar um mundo no qual as pessoas e a natureza prosperem. Estamos enraizados em nossa Missão e guiados por nossos Valores, que incluem o Compromisso com a Diversidade e o Respeito às Pessoas, Comunidades e Culturas. Seja desenvolvimento de carreira, horários flexíveis ou uma missão gratificante, há muitas razões para amar a vida na TNC. Quer ter uma visão melhor da TNC? Confira nossa conta no instagram e o Relatório Anual 2024, além da #tncbrasil no LinkedIn.

Nosso objetivo é cultivar um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo para que todos os nossos colegas em todo o mundo sintam um sentimento de pertencimento e que suas contribuições únicas para nossa missão sejam valorizadas. Sabemos que só alcançaremos nossa Missão contratando e engajando uma força de trabalho diversificada que reflita as comunidades em que trabalhamos. Além dos requisitos em nossas postagens, reconhecemos que as pessoas vêm com talento e experiências fora do trabalho. A diversidade de experiências e habilidades combinadas com paixão são a chave para a inovação e uma cultura de inclusão! Por favor, inscreva-se - adoraríamos ouvir de você. Para citar o que inúmeros membros da equipe da TNC dizem: “você se juntará por causa da nossa missão e ficará por nossas pessoas”.

Nosso impacto

  • 71 milhões de hectares: impacto positivo almejado até 2030, com foco em conservação e aprimoramento da gestão.

  • 187 mil km de rios: extensão para a qual a TNC Brasil busca promover soluções e políticas públicas de conservação até 2030.

  • 369 milhões de toneladas de CO₂: volume de emissões que a organização pretende capturar ou contribuir para reduzir até 2030.

  • 3,8 milhões de pessoas: público que a TNC Brasil pretende apoiar, com atenção especial a povos tradicionais e comunidades indígenas, ampliando sua participação em espaços decisórios e sua liderança na gestão dos territórios.

Na Amazônia, exemplos recentes ajudam a dimensionar essa atuação: um projeto de Pagamento por Serviços Ambientais na Terra do Meio envolve 14 territórios coletivos, 3 mil pessoas e 10 milhões de hectares sob proteção de uso sustentável.

Propósito do cargo

Liderar a estratégia da TNC na Amazônia Brasileira a partir de uma visão sistêmica do território, conciliando conservação e desenvolvimento socioeconômico. O desafio será conectar diferentes agendas, atores e investimentos para transformar estratégias em resultados concretos e escaláveis, capazes de manter a floresta em pé, promover uma produção responsável e gerar valor para as pessoas e comunidades da Amazônia.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Acompanhar e implementar a estratégia e a Teoria da Mudança da TNC para a Amazônia Brasileira, traduzindo a visão institucional em prioridades, iniciativas e resultados mensuráveis.

  • Liderar um portfólio amplo e diverso, conectando agendas de produção agropecuária sustentável, proteção e valorização da floresta em pé, povos indígenas e comunidades tradicionais, clima, mecanismos financeiros e políticas públicas.

  • Assegurar capacidade de implementação e entrega, transformando estratégias em resultados concretos, monitorando avanços e adaptando planos diante de mudanças de contexto.

  • Promover uma visão de desenvolvimento socioeconômico da Amazônia, articulando conservação e produção responsável e identificando alavancas econômicas capazes de valorizar a floresta em pé.

  • Identificar oportunidades para ampliar iniciativas bem-sucedidas, superando a lógica de projetos-piloto e promovendo soluções com potencial de transformação sistêmica e atuação em larga escala.

  • Construir e fortalecer relações estratégicas com governos estaduais e federal, setor privado, instituições financeiras, produtores, academia, organizações da sociedade civil, financiadores, povos indígenas, quilombolas, extrativistas e outras comunidades tradicionais.

  • Influenciar políticas públicas, estruturas de governança e processos de tomada de decisão relevantes para o desenvolvimento sustentável da Amazônia.

  • Liderar e apoiar a captação de recursos no Brasil e internacionalmente, mantendo um pipeline consistente de oportunidades e relacionamento estratégico com financiadores.

  • Supervisionar a gestão financeira e orçamentária de um portfólio de grande porte, assegurando uso eficiente dos recursos, sustentabilidade financeira e conformidade institucional.

  • Liderar gestores e equipes multidisciplinares, fortalecendo estruturas, responsabilidades, autonomia, accountability e capacidades técnicas e gerenciais.

  • Estimular integração e sinergia entre diferentes frentes de atuação, evitando silos e promovendo circulação de contexto e informação para qualificar a tomada de decisão.

  • Manter e fortalecer a agenda de diversidade, equidade e inclusão dentro da unidade, incorporando-a à liderança e à gestão da equipe.

  • Representar institucionalmente a TNC em fóruns, negociações e espaços estratégicos nacionais e internacionais.

Requisitos e competências para trabalhar conosco

Educação

  • Formação superior completa em áreas relacionadas à gestão de recursos naturais, políticas públicas, economia ou áreas afins. Pós-graduação em áreas correlatas será considerada desejável.

Experiência

  • Mínimo de 10 anos de experiência profissional em posições relacionadas a desenvolvimento socioeconômico, gestão de recursos naturais, políticas públicas, conservação ou áreas correlatas, com trajetória relevante em contextos complexos e de grande escala.

  • Experiência robusta na definição e implementação de estratégias, com responsabilidade por portfólios complexos, priorização de iniciativas, gestão de riscos e entrega de resultados mensuráveis.

  • Experiência comprovada na liderança de gestores e equipes multidisciplinares, incluindo desenvolvimento de talentos, estruturação de equipes e gestão de desempenho.

  • Trajetória de articulação multissetorial, estabelecendo relações e conduzindo negociações complexas com governos, setor privado, organizações da sociedade civil, comunidades, financiadores e outros atores estratégicos.

  • Experiência em relações governamentais e políticas públicas, incluindo capacidade de influenciar agendas, processos decisórios e condições institucionais necessárias para alcançar resultados em escala.

  • Experiência na gestão financeira e orçamentária de programas de grande porte, combinando visão estratégica com capacidade de acompanhamento da execução.

  • Experiência em captação de recursos e relacionamento com financiadores, contribuindo para a construção e manutenção de um pipeline de financiamento no Brasil e/ou internacionalmente.

  • Será especialmente valorizada uma trajetória que demonstre conhecimento e compreensão do contexto amazônico, incluindo suas dinâmicas socioeconômicas, produtivas, ambientais, políticas e territoriais.

  • Será um diferencial experiência com mecanismos financeiros, finanças estruturadas, setor privado ou desenvolvimento econômico, especialmente quando aplicada a desafios socioambientais e/ou territoriais.

    Conhecimento e habilidades

  • Visão sistêmica da Amazônia: capacidade de compreender o território para além de uma única agenda temática, conectando desenvolvimento socioeconômico, conservação, produção agropecuária, floresta, clima, povos e comunidades tradicionais, políticas públicas e investimentos.

  • Pensamento estratégico e de escala: capacidade de identificar as principais alavancas de transformação de um sistema e desenvolver soluções que possam avançar de iniciativas pontuais para resultados de maior escala.

  • Gestão e implementação: capacidade de transformar estratégia em execução, estabelecer prioridades, acompanhar resultados e replanejar recursos e ações diante de mudanças de contexto.

  • Articulação e negociação: habilidade para navegar entre interesses distintos, construir agendas comuns e mobilizar atores públicos, privados e sociais em torno de objetivos compartilhados.

  • Visão econômico-financeira: capacidade de compreender o papel de investimentos, mecanismos financeiros, setor privado e modelos econômicos na construção de soluções sustentáveis para a Amazônia.

  • Captação e mobilização de recursos: habilidade para desenvolver relações com financiadores, identificar oportunidades e contribuir estrategicamente para a sustentabilidade financeira do portfólio.

  • Inglês avançado, oral e escrito, considerando as interações, apresentações e eventos internacionais inerentes à posição. Inglês fluente é desejável e conhecimentos de espanhol serão considerados um diferencial.

Competências

  • Visão sistêmica e pensamento estratégico: conecta diferentes variáveis e agendas, compreende interdependências e mantém uma visão ampla do território sem perder a capacidade de priorização.

  • Orientação à implementação e resultados: transforma estratégia em ação, acompanha a execução e mantém foco consistente nas entregas e no impacto esperado.

  • Liderança adaptativa: lidera com segurança em contextos de incerteza e complexidade, sendo capaz de rever planos, redirecionar prioridades e mobilizar o time diante de mudanças.

  • Influência e construção de consensos: estabelece relações de confiança e consegue aproximar atores com interesses e perspectivas distintas.

  • Liderança de pessoas: desenvolve equipes fortes e tecnicamente qualificadas, compartilha contexto, promove autonomia e evita a formação de silos na tomada de decisão.

  • Colaboração e integração: consegue navegar por um portfólio diverso sem precisar ser especialista em todas as temáticas, conectando conhecimentos, pessoas e iniciativas para gerar sinergias.

  • Proatividade e senso de protagonismo: antecipa necessidades, identifica oportunidades e mobiliza recursos e pessoas para fazer a estratégia avançar.

  • Compromisso com diversidade, equidade e inclusão: incorpora essa agenda à forma de liderar, desenvolver equipes e construir uma cultura organizacional inclusiva.

Perfil de nossa equipe

A The Nature Conservancy é enraizada em nossa missão e guiada por nossos valores. Temos o compromisso de cultivar um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo, onde todos os colegas ao redor do mundo sintam um senso de pertencimento e tenham suas contribuições únicas valorizadas. Nosso objetivo é construir uma força de trabalho diversa que reflita as comunidades em que atuamos, reconhecendo que a diversidade de experiências e habilidades é fundamental para a inovação.

“Você vai se juntar a nós pela nossa missão — e vai ficar pelas nossas pessoas.”

Principais interesses para trabalhar conosco

O candidato ideal será motivado pela oportunidade de causar um impacto direto nos esforços globais de conservação.

Deve ter um forte interesse em sustentabilidade ambiental, proteção da biodiversidade e conservação de ecossistemas críticos no Brasil.

Razões para se juntar à nossa equipe

  • A oportunidade de liderar uma estratégia de alta relevância para um dos biomas mais importantes para a biodiversidade e estabilidade climática global.

  • Atuação sobre desafios complexos que conectam desenvolvimento econômico, produção sustentável, conservação, clima, comunidades e políticas públicas.

  • Liderança de um portfólio diversificado e de uma equipe multidisciplinar em uma organização de alcance global.

  • Possibilidade de articular governos, setor privado, investidores, financiadores, comunidades e sociedade civil em torno de mudanças sistêmicas.

  • Espaço para construir soluções que ultrapassem projetos-piloto e alcancem escala e transformação de sistemas.

Detalhes relevantes antes de se candidatar a esta vaga

A posição exige residência fixa em uma capital da Amazônia Brasileira, em modelo home office. Também requer disponibilidade para viagens nacionais e internacionais e atuação eventual em locais remotos e condições climáticas ou de terreno desafiadoras.

Employment Attorney

You will be working alongside experienced attorneys in a very collaborative and forward-thinking environment.


Duties:

  • Conduct legal research and draft memoranda on a variety of labor and employment law issues.

  • Support senior attorneys in fact investigations, witness interviews, and the development of case strategy.

  • Prepare responses to administrative charges and complaints before agencies such as the EEOC, DFEH/CRD, and DLSE.

  • Draft and review employment-related documents, including workplace policies, employee handbooks, and employment agreements.

  • Participate in client meetings and calls, providing updates and supporting ongoing client communications.

  • Monitor changes in labor and employment laws and draft client alerts or updates under supervision.

  • Collaborate closely with partners and associates in a team-oriented environment, with opportunities for training and mentorship.

Requirements:

  • Member in good standing with the California Bar.

  • 2 - 4 years of attorney experience in CA Labor & Employment Law

  • Strong preference for Wage and Hour and FEHA, but open to all Employment Law Experience

  • Excellent research, writing, and analytical skills

  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities

  • 1900 billable hours

Compensation & Benefits:

  • Salary range is between $150,000 and $180,000

  • Year-end discretionary bonus potential

  • 401(k) plan with annual employer contribution; employee deferrals

  • Medical (HMO/PPO options), dental, and vision coverage

  • Dependent coverage and domestic partner coverage are available

  • Life Insurance: Group and supplemental life insurance options are available

  • Long-term disability and long-term care insurance options are available

  • Employee well-being initiatives, including EAP professional counseling and referral services

  • Competitive vacation and sick leave, paid firm holidays

  • Monthly travel and/or parking allowance offered

  • Events for holidays, birthday commemorations, special staff acknowledgments, and annual events

  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA)/Plans – Sections 125 and 132 plans available

  • Onboarding and in-house training programs, continuing learning, and professional growth and development opportunities

Location:

  • Must reside and be admitted to Practice in California

  • Remote

Please note that we at Career Consulting Partners will be sure to keep your information private. We will not submit you or your information to any firm without your consent. Once we have received your resume/application, we will reach out to you and review the firm(s) before we move forward. Feel free to visit our career site ***

raw.description:
Are you ready to be a big part of something big?

At Trader Interactive, we make buying and selling a great experience. We're a group of go-getters who decided they didn't want to settle for the status quo. We come together as one team to build value and drive innovation across our industries - but we have fun while we do it and make sure our people are always our #1 priority.

When it comes to your career, we want to provide big opportunities to help you make a big impact. But for this to be possible, we strive to feel small. Small enough to quickly change tack, small enough to learn from different teams and small enough to connect authentically with leadership.

And one of the best parts? We give you the freedom to work from whatever working location works best for you and your lifestyle - yes, this means you can be 100% remote if you want to be!

What We Offer

  • An inclusive and supportive work environment where you can move your career forward and will have the chance to do work that has real, significant impact on the world.

  • The opportunity to be a part of a global group of digital marketplace businesses (CAR Group) located across Australia, Brazil, Chile and South Korea - collectively we have around 1,800 team members worldwide, and our Global Talent Exchange Program means you might just find yourself working in one of those businesses sometime soon.

  • Plenty of flexible leave options and employee benefits including up to 31 days of paid time off in your first year, continuing education with access to LinkedIn Learning, a full benefits package including medical, dental & vision, 401K with company match, and wellness program.

What You'll Do

The Senior Product Manager (AI) is responsible for defining, delivering, and iterating AI-powered products and capabilities throughout the product life cycle — connecting data, machine learning, and large language models to real customer/consumer problems and measurable business outcomes.

  • Own the vision, strategy, and market fit for AI-powered products and experiences within your domain (e.g., recommendations, pricing, search, workflow automation, conversational tools).

  • Build deep consumer and dealer understanding through interviews, discovery sessions, and usage analytics to identify where AI can add real value (and where it should not be used).

  • Serve as internal and external subject matter expert on your AI products, including their capabilities, limitations, and responsible-use guidelines, measurement and monitoring.

  • Own the end-to-end product plan for AI capabilities, from discovery and problem framing through launch, adoption, and continuous optimization.

  • Drive innovative, AI-enabled solutions that align to strategic business goals and are grounded in realistic data, model, and UX constraints.

  • Gather business and data requirements from a variety of sources (consumers, dealers, account owners, sales, support, data science) and translate them into clear product outcomes and increments.

  • Document and elaborate requirements, partnering with business and technology leadership to prioritize AI opportunities within the overall product roadmap.

  • Maintain and prioritize a large product backlog that includes discovery, experimentation, and delivery work for AI features, as well as the data and tech debt required to keep them healthy.

  • Serve as subject matter expert in relevant product domains, assisting with customer UAT, defect triage, and mitigation efforts — with particular attention to AI-specific issues such as output quality, bias, hallucination, and safety.

  • Partner with stakeholders to define minimum viable products for AI features, balancing value, feasibility, risk, and responsible-use considerations.

  • Inspect, accept, or reject completed development work against defined acceptance criteria, UX standards, and key performance metrics for AI behaviors.

  • Communicate work in progress, results from experiments, and upcoming priorities to key internal and external stakeholders in a clear, non-hype way.

  • Collaborate across Data, Sales, Design, other Product teams, QA, and Engineering to produce prototypes and proof-of-concept experiences that validate AI opportunities quickly.

  • Collaborate with software development and data science to build robust, scalable AI solutions for existing and potential customers.

  • Develop a nuanced understanding of the target markets and user bases (including their workflows and risk tolerance) to guide decisions on AI product backlog and prioritization.

  • Contribute to business cases that justify AI investments, clearly articulating expected value, costs (including model and infrastructure costs), and key risks.

  • Conduct customer, market, and competitive analysis to identify industry trends, market gaps, and unmet customer needs, with a specific lens on how AI is changing user expectations.

  • Act as project manager lead in strategic AI initiatives for discovery and delivery, ensuring tight coordination across teams.

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's Degree in product management, business administration, engineering or a related field.

  • 4-6 years of relevant product management, product ownership, business analytics or beta analytics experience in a software product development environment.

  • 5+ years of relevant product management, product ownership, or closely related experience in a software product development environment, including 2+ years working on AI/ML-powered features or data products.

  • Experience in a role with strong requirements elicitation and stakeholder management across technical and non-technical groups.

  • Experience with customer support and bug tracking.

  • Experience and proficiency with modern product and collaboration tools (e.g., JIRA, yED, G Suite); familiarity with analytics or experimentation tools is a plus (Optimizely, Fullstory, Adobe, etc.).

  • Previous experience in marketplaces, advertising, e-commerce, SaaS, or other data-rich domains is a plus.

Bonus Points

Not specified in this posting.

So come and join our team - because every role is a big role in our plans to go big.

TI proudly supports a diverse workforce, and we encourage candidates from underrepresented groups to apply. Trader Interactive is an equal opportunity employer where hiring is based entirely on business needs, job requirements, and individual merit.

About the Client

Our client is one of the nation's largest performance marketing organizations specializing in real estate lead generation. With more than $20 million in annual paid media spend, the company has built its success through data-driven decision making, relentless testing, and scalable customer acquisition strategies. Every marketing dollar is invested into growing their own business, making performance, efficiency, and ROI the driving force behind every campaign. As they continue to expand, they are seeking a highly experienced Director of Paid Media to lead and scale their acquisition engine while building world-class paid media and creative operations. This is a fully remote opportunity for candidates located within the United States.Job Summary

The Director of Paid Media is a senior leadership role for a highly hands-on marketing operator who enjoys being deeply involved in both strategy and execution. This individual will oversee more than $20 million in annual paid media spend across Meta, Connected TV (CTV), Paid Search, Native, Display, and emerging acquisition channels while leading the company's creative performance strategy.

This role goes well beyond media buying. The Director will oversee the creative team responsible for ad content, messaging, editing, production, testing, and campaign execution, ensuring every creative asset is built with performance and measurable ROI in mind while maintaining quality and increasing spend. They will develop scalable systems for experimentation, optimization, reporting, and forecasting while continuously identifying opportunities to improve lead quality, reduce acquisition costs, and increase return on ad spend.

The ideal candidate has extensive experience within high-volume lead generation organizations—particularly companies that invest significant marketing dollars into generating their own customers rather than managing campaigns for outside clients or agencies. They are equally comfortable analyzing campaign performance, directing creative strategy, building operational processes, and personally working inside advertising platforms to drive results.

What We Offer

  • $160k - $175k Base Salary

  • Performance-based bonus opportunities = On-Target-Earnings (OTE) of $200k+

  • Fully remote position (U.S.-based)

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • Paid Time Off and company holidays

  • 401(k) with company match (if applicable)

  • Executive-level ownership of a $20M+ annual paid media budget

  • Opportunity to build and lead a best-in-class performance marketing organization

  • Collaborative, fast-paced, data-driven culture

  • Significant career growth with direct executive visibility

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Own the strategy, execution, optimization, and scaling of a $20M+ annual paid media budget across Meta, CTV, Paid Search, Native, Display, and emerging channels.

  • Remain highly hands-on within advertising platforms, personally monitoring campaign performance and driving optimization efforts.

  • Lead and mentor the creative team responsible for ad copy, video production, graphic design, editing, messaging, and campaign execution.

  • Ensure all creative initiatives are driven by measurable performance, testing frameworks, and return on investment.

  • Build structured experimentation programs that continuously improve creative performance, lead quality, and customer acquisition costs.

  • Develop scalable marketing systems for campaign launches, QA, reporting, forecasting, budgeting, and operational excellence.

  • Partner cross-functionally with executive leadership to align paid media strategy with overall business objectives.

  • Develop executive dashboards and reporting that clearly communicate campaign performance, business impact, and future growth opportunities.

  • Identify new acquisition channels, audience opportunities, and scaling strategies while maintaining profitability and efficiency.

  • Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, continuous testing, and data-driven decision making across the marketing organization.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

  • 8+ years of hands-on performance marketing experience with increasing leadership responsibility.

  • Proven success managing $20M+ annual paid media budgets with strong ROAS and customer acquisition performance.

  • Extensive expertise managing Meta Ads and Connected TV (CTV) campaigns at scale.

  • Strong experience with Paid Search, Native Advertising, Display, and other digital acquisition channels.

  • Experience leading creative teams responsible for content strategy, ad production, editing, testing, optimization, and performance measurement.

  • Proven background within lead generation businesses that invest heavily in acquiring their own customers—not agency-side marketing.

  • Deep understanding of attribution, conversion tracking, analytics, forecasting, and performance reporting.

  • Demonstrated ability to build scalable marketing systems, testing frameworks, and operational processes.

  • Exceptional leadership, analytical, communication, and project management skills with a passion for continuous optimization and measurable business growth.

raw.description:
Collinson is the global, privately-owned company dedicated to helping the world to travel with ease and confidence. The group offers a unique blend of industry and sector specialists who together provide market-leading airport experiences, loyalty and customer engagement, and insurance solutions for over 400 million consumers.

Collinson is the operator of Priority Pass, the world’s original and leading airport experiences programme. Travellers can access a network of 1,500+ lounges and travel experiences, including dining, retail, sleep and spa, in over 650 airports in 148 countries, helping to elevate the journey into something special. We work with the world’s leading payment networks, over 1,400 banks, 90 airlines and 20 hotel groups worldwide.

We have been bringing innovation to the market since inception – from launching the first independent global VIP lounge access Programme, Priority Pass to being the first to sell direct travel insurance in the UK through Columbus Direct and creating the first loyalty agency of its kind in the travel sector with ICLP. Today we still invest heavily in innovation to ensure that we continue to deliver superior customer experiences.

Key clients include Mastercard, American Express, Cathay Pacific, British Airways, LATAM, Flying Blue, Accor, EasyJet, HSBC, Chase, HDFC.

Our mission is focused on doing good beyond profit, which for us means we seek out opportunities for our people to share in our success and that we give back to the communities and people within which we work.

Never short of ambition, the success of our business is delivered through the diverse and talented team of over 2,200 global colleagues.

We're growing our team in Poland and want to be upfront about how this role is structured. As we don't yet have a legal entity in Poland, we work with an Employer of Record (EOR) or umbrella company to onboard talent in the region. This means the role is offered on a fixed term basis via an international contractor agreement — and is fully remote.

Purpose of the job:

The Senior IOS Developer at Collinson's Travel Experience Division will be at the forefront of bringing

our visionary roadmap to life, focusing on delivering globally appealing, customer centric solutions.

Acknowledging the importance of regional nuances, the chosen candidate will guarantee that our

digital offerings strike a chord at both the universal and localized levels. This role is pivotal in

architecting and developing iOS applications that offer a smooth, user-friendly travel experience for

our global clientele.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and build advanced applications for the iOS platform.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features.

  • Maintain and improve existing codebase, focusing on continuous integration and deployment strategies.

  • Work on bug fixing and improving application performance.

  • Ensure the best possible performance, quality, and responsiveness of the application.

  • Integrate with third-party libraries and APIs, ensuring seamless functionality.

  • Continuously discover, evaluate, and implement new technologies to maximize development efficiency.

  • Coordinate with the design team to ensure UI/UX best practices are followed.

  • Address any security vulnerabilities and work to ensure a secure app environment.

  • Stay updated with the latest mobile trends, architectures, and emerging technologies.

Knowledge, skills and experience required

  • 4-8 years of strong design/development experience overall, with 4+ years of mobile development experience

  • You have hands-on experience building mobile applications using Swift, and solid understanding of iOS app design principles, patterns, and best practices.

  • You care about user interaction, usability, and of course, making the interface beautiful.

  • Good knowledge of architectural design patterns such as MVVM and MVP, and provenexperience ensuring modularized and scalable app architecture.

  • Proven experience integrating AI-assisted development tools and techniques into everyday workflows (e.g. code generation, testing, debugging, performance analysis, or automation)

  • You have experience with Cocoapods dependency management in iOS apps

  • You strive for clean code and know how to write flexible tests that won't break and have experience with different test strategies, such as unit, snapshot etc.

  • Good knowledge of design patterns mostly used in mobile development (dependency injection, observers etc)

  • You love coding and take the time to reflect on all aspects of your implementation, be it the frameworks, languages or processes.

  • Ability to take ownership and drive the development of exciting and impactful new features and products.

  • A genuine passion for writing well-structured, readable, and maintainable code

  • You thrive in a team where you can learn and try new tech, collaborate on technical challenges and grow as a team.

Interview Process:

We want our process to be fair and transparent, so it's only right that we tell you what the various interview stages are:

Stage 1 - We'll do a short call with one of our Engineering Managers for around 30 minutes, who will

tell you more about the team, our products, technology and ask questions about your career history

and suitability for the role.

Stage 2 - You will do a technical test (at home) and we'll review your solution and approach to it

Stage 3 - We'll meet you for 60-90 minutes and you'll get to spend time with different members of

the engineering team (Engineering Manager/Lead). through your technical test and ask

questions on some of your decisions and implementation.

Stage 4 - 30-60 minute discussion with Head of Architecture & Engineering

Collinson is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes differences in all their forms including: colour, race, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, neurodivergence, family status, age, individuals with disabilities and people from all backgrounds, cultures and experiences as we strongly believe this contributes to our on-going success.

We are focused on continually evolving our purpose driven, high performing culture, providing an environment where our people have the opportunity to achieve their full potential and do interesting and meaningful work. Our company values are: Take Action, Do the right thing, One team and Be insight led. These help guide everything we do internally in terms of how we think, act and interact, right through to how we deliver value to our customers and clients.

In your application, please feel free to note which pronouns you use (For example - she/her/hers, he/him/his, they/them/theirs, etc).

If you need any extra support throughout the interview process, then please email us

Selection process developed by matteria

Location and Work Mode

REMOTE

Who we are

Momentous is an AI engineering company that designs, builds, and operates production AI systems for organizations across industries — from global technology companies and healthcare providers to government bodies and experiential agencies. Their work spans custom AI products, agentic systems, computer vision, knowledge platforms, and the infrastructure behind them, all grounded in a consistent methodology: discover the real friction, design the right solution, deliver with precision, and transfer full ownership to the client's team. Momentous doesn't create dependency — they transfer capability.

Our impact

At Momentous, impact isn't a side project — it's a founding commitment. Twenty percent of our engineering capacity is permanently allocated to sustainability and social impact work, written into our structure before we had a single paying client. That's what produced WasteLens, a computer vision platform helping restaurants and hotel chains across Latin America reduce food waste in line with UN SDG 12. These projects aren't charity — they're some of our sharpest engineering work. Building for communities with tight budgets and diverse users forces a precision that makes everything else we build better. When you join Momentous, one-fifth of your time goes toward work that matters beyond the bottom line. Non-negotiable, and it always has been.

Purpose of the Position

Momentous is hiring a Software Engineer to own end-to-end delivery on the production AI systems we build for our clients. Engagements span custom AI products, knowledge platforms, agentic systems, computer vision, and the infrastructure that runs them. You will own the work shipped under your name, pair with senior engineers on the more complex builds, and contribute to architectural decisions on the systems you build, alongside senior engineers.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end delivery of features and projects: design, implementation, deployment, and the client conversation around them

  • Team Management Experience

  • Pair with senior engineers on complex builds, owning meaningful slices independently

  • Build production AI workflows: RAG components, integrations across cloud platforms, agentic automations

  • Review pull requests from associate engineers

  • Write design notes that the team uses; contribute to architectural conversations

Requirements and competences to work with us

Experience

  • 5+ years shipping production code with end-to-end ownership of features

  • Full-stack range across modern web (TypeScript, React, Next.js) and a backend language (Python or Node), with comfort across relational databases and a cloud platform (we use GCP)

  • Working fluency withClaude Codeor comparable agentic engineering tooling — used daily on real work, with the judgement to direct AI on multi-step tasks and identify when its output is wrong

  • Strong async written communication: PR descriptions, design notes, written code reviews

  • Direct comfort in front of a client: standups, demos, scoping conversations

  • Team Management Experience

Knowledge and Skills

  • Bilingual English / Spanish

  • Production experience with Vertex AI, Gemini, or the Claude / Anthropic API

  • Specific GCP depth (Cloud Run, Cloud Build, Vertex AI, IAM)

  • Experience with agentic workflow tooling, MCP servers, or RAG systems in production

  • Open-source contributions or production-grade side projects

Competencies

  • Comfortable working remotely and available during LATAM / US Pacific business hours overlap.

  • Good communication skills and client management.

  • Proactive and curious attitude.

Our team profile

At Momentous, the team is intentionally diverse — in background, discipline, and perspective — united by a shared belief that AI is a tool to amplify human capability, not replace it. We care deeply about how we work together: partnerships built on trust, communication that's direct and honest, and a culture where people are expected to grow, challenge ideas, and own their work. Whether you're working with a client or a teammate, the relationship matters as much as the output.

Reasons to join our team

  • Trust-based time off (minimum 4 weeks per year)

  • Equipment stipend

  • Annual learning and conference budget

  • Health coverage per local market

  • Career progression: most Software Engineers progress to Senior Applied AI Engineer within 18–30 months based on demonstrated capability

Equal Opportunity

Momentous is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members.

Relevant details before applying for this vacancy

This is a full-time position that requires your complete focus and dedication. We are not looking for candidates with active side jobs or parallel commitments — we expect this role to be your primary professional engagement.

Important Notice for Applicants:
At Bixal, we want to ensure a transparent and secure application process for all candidates. Official communication will come from an email address ending in @bixal.com or from @bixal.na.teamtailor-mail.com. Messages from other sources may be fraudulent, and you should exercise care to avoid any links or attachments included.

Bixal will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

Need Assistance or a Reasonable Accommodation?If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation to complete your application, we're here to help. Please reach out to us at and let us know how we can support you. You do not need to share personal details or disclose the nature of your request. You can expect a response from a team member within 24 hours during the regular work week and on the next operating day during the weekend or holidays.

Why Bixal?

Bixal is a consulting company headquartered in Fairfax, VA, working alongside governments and organizations to help them deliver better services and experiences to the communities they serve. Using evidence-based knowledge and technology, Bixal empowers clients to deliver on their missions more effectively by fostering a culture of learning and continuous improvement.

Our values:

  • People-First: Emphasizing the importance of people in all aspects of work.

  • Collaboration and Transparency: Valuing teamwork and open communication.

  • Growth Mindset: Encouraging innovation and continuous improvement.

  • Creating Lasting Impact: Focusing on meaningful outcomes and positive change.

About the role:

Bixal is seeking a Content Strategist / Information Architect for a project that supports a large-scale outreach and engagement effort, delivering strategic communications, content and creative services, digital strategy, and audience engagement across public-facing websites, applications, and social media platforms. raw.description:
Important Notice for Applicants:
At Bixal, we want to ensure a transparent and secure application process for all candidates. Official communication will come from an email address ending in @bixal.com or from @bixal.na.teamtailor-mail.com. Messages from other sources may be fraudulent, and you should exercise care to avoid any links or attachments included.

Bixal will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

Need Assistance or a Reasonable Accommodation?If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation to complete your application, we're here to help. Please reach out to us at and let us know how we can support you. You do not need to share personal details or disclose the nature of your request. You can expect a response from a team member within 24 hours during the regular work week and on the next operating day during the weekend or holidays.

Why Bixal?

Bixal is a consulting company headquartered in Fairfax, VA, working alongside governments and organizations to help them deliver better services and experiences to the communities they serve. Using evidence-based knowledge and technology, Bixal empowers clients to deliver on their missions more effectively by fostering a culture of learning and continuous improvement.

Our values:

  • People-First: Emphasizing the importance of people in all aspects of work.

  • Collaboration and Transparency: Valuing teamwork and open communication.

  • Growth Mindset: Encouraging innovation and continuous improvement.

  • Creating Lasting Impact: Focusing on meaningful outcomes and positive change.

About the role:

Bixal is seeking a Knowledge Management Specialist, Service Delivery to build and run the knowledge layer behind a large-scale federal support program serving a diverse community of users.

In your first 90 days, you will stand up the program’s Tier 0 self-service knowledge base for both external users and internal staff. From there, you will manage the article lifecycle that keeps the knowledge base accurate, useful, and trustworthy, while developing the operating documentation that supports Tier 1 through Tier 3 help desk operations. This role suits someone who sees a knowledge base as a product with users, not simply a repository of documents.

Hundreds of thousands of people rely on the program’s digital services and resources each year. When someone gets stuck, the difference between answering their own question in thirty seconds and waiting for support often comes down to the quality of the knowledge layer behind the help desk.

This project supports a large-scale outreach and engagement effort, delivering strategic communications, content and creative services, digital strategy, and audience engagement across public-facing websites, applications, and social media platforms. The work is paired with the IT, cybersecurity, and data operations needed to keep that digital presence secure, reliable, and available around the clock. The program's mission is to ensure the intended audience receives timely, accurate, and accessible information about the programs, services, and policies that affect them with content and platforms built to scale, adapt to changing needs, and hold up to federal compliance and security standards.

This is a full-time position contingent on contract award by our client, with a defined performance period of one year with two one-year option periods. This role offers you a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a project that aligns with Bixal’s mission of delivering innovative, human-centered solutions. While the role has a fixed duration, we are committed to transparency and collaboration, keeping you informed about contract updates and new opportunities. At Bixal, we support your professional journey, ensuring your experience reflects our inclusive, purpose-driven culture and prepares you for future success.

Location

This role can work remotely from anywhere in the USA. You must be legally authorized to work in the US.  Bixal does not provide visa sponsorship.

Compensation:

The salary range for this role is $77,000 – $87,000. In the spirit of transparency, most offers tend to land near the midpoint of the range. We make compensation decisions thoughtfully, considering your experience, the skills you bring, and our commitment to internal equity. Fairness and transparency are core to how we operate.

Responsibilities:

Knowledge Base & Content Governance

  • Build and maintain the Tier 0 self-service knowledge base.

  • Run the full lifecycle of knowledge articles.

  • Implement taxonomy, tagging, metadata, and content governance.

  • Maintain the boundary between public and internal content.

Help Desk & Operational Knowledge

  • Write and maintain Tier 1–3 help desk SOPs, account setup/maintenance SOPs, and outage-notification processes.

  • Partner with Tier 1–3 support staff, engineering, and cybersecurity to capture and document knowledge.

  • Keep support guidance consistent across phone, email, chat, and social media.

Measurement & User Experience

  • Analyze query volume, resolution rates, and support trends to identify knowledge gaps.

  • Contribute to customer journey mapping and target content to common friction points.

Enablement & Knowledge Adoption

  • Produce interactive video tutorials and job aids.

  • Train help desk and program staff to submit, review, and use knowledge content.

  • Other relevant duties as qualified/trained to perform

Qualifications:

  • Active Secret clearance. An interim Secret is acceptable to start.

  • Bachelor's degree, or equivalent professional experience.

  • At least 4 years in knowledge management, technical writing, documentation development, or content operations.

  • Hands-on experience with an enterprise knowledge base, documentation platform, or content management system.

  • Experience supporting a service desk or IT operations environment, with a working understanding of tiered support models and familiarity with ITIL practices for knowledge management, incident, problem and change.

  • Direct responsibility for the taxonomy, metadata and content governance of a knowledge base or documentation library — structured authoring and standards, not writing alone.

  • Demonstrated ability to draw knowledge out of subject-matter experts, interviewing technical staff and turning what they know into documentation someone else can follow.

  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex technical material into clear, plain-language content that a non-technical reader can act on.

Nice to Have Skills and Experience:

  • ITIL v4 Foundation certification, or willingness to obtain it within 90 days of start.

  • Experience supporting a federal or DoD program.

  • Familiarity with service portals and workflow automation — ServiceNow or a comparable ITSM platform.

  • Experience writing for a military, veteran, or military family audience.

  • Working knowledge of Section 508 and WCAG requirements as they apply to published support content.

  • A habit of measuring knowledge content by whether it actually deflected the ticket, not by page views.

How We Support Our Team:

  • Flex hours

  • 401K with matching incentive

  • Parental Leave

  • Medical/dental/vision benefits

  • Flex Spending Account

  • Company provided short-term disability and life insurance

  • Commuter benefits

  • Paid Time Off (PTO)

  • 11 Paid holidays

Our company is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all individuals and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local anti-discrimination laws. Employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.

raw.description:
About IN2

IN2 is an award-winning specialist communications, development, and research company dedicated to creating positive change for communities in rapidly changing environments. We use innovative and engaging two-way communications to create impact across the full spectrum of geo-political and socio-economic issues, including global security, international development, business transformation, and climate change.

IN2 combines a global geopolitical outlook with a rich understanding of local grassroots sentiment to help clients develop, deliver, and measure engagement campaigns that connect our clients with their intended audiences in a language, manner, and medium that feels natural to them.

With our track record of delivering culturally sensitive campaigns in challenging and higher-risk environments around the world, IN2 has become a trusted partner and advisor to a range of clients from national governments and transnational institutions to global brands and international NGOs.

IN2 has offices in the UK, UAE, Jordan, Iraq, Poland, and Kenya.

IN2’s professionally and culturally diverse 180-strong staff hail from 20 countries. We are committed to diversity in our workplace.

Operations & Project Coordinator

We are looking for a proactive, versatile, and problem-solving Operations & Project Coordinator to act as the right hand to the Country Manager of IN2 in Ukraine.

In this role, you will help streamline internal country operations, support the execution of specific projects, and assist with business development efforts (including bid writing) and project evaluation (MEL). This is a dynamic role designed for someone who can quickly grasp the context of a task, work independently, and relieve the Country Manager’s workload by driving specific assignments forward.

This position is offered on a fixed-term basis until 30 April 2027, with the potential for extension depending on project needs.

Responsibilities:

  • Operational Coordination: Assist in optimizing workflows, managing internal documentation, and streamlining communications across country operations.
  • Task Execution: Take charge of specific, targeted tasks within ongoing projects as assigned by the Country Manager.
  • Follow-ups & Tracking: Track project deadlines, milestones, and action items to ensure smooth project implementation.
  • Proposal Writing: Assist in drafting, editing, and assembling high-quality project proposals, concepts, and bids for international donors.
  • Market & Donor Tracking: Help monitor funding opportunities, donor pipelines, and open tenders in Ukraine.
  • Documentation Prep: Prepare necessary institutional documents and background materials for upcoming bids.
  • Data Collection: Support the gathering of qualitative and quantitative data from project sites or partners.
  • Reporting Assistance: Help draft clear, data-driven progress reports for donors and internal stakeholders based on established MEL indicators.
  • Tracking Logs: Maintain update logs and spreadsheets related to project performance and lessons learned.

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in project coordination, administration, or business development.
  • Prior experience working within international development projects, humanitarian organizations, INGOs, or collaborating with Ukrainian state institutions/ministries.
  • Practical experience in assisting with grant/proposal writing and a solid understanding of monitoring and evaluation concepts (KPIs, logical frameworks).
  • Practical understanding of how international donors (e.g., USAID, EU, UN agencies) operate.
  • Advanced English and Ukrainian (both written and spoken) are required, as you will be drafting parts of proposals and reports in English.
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of tasks.
  • Quick learner with the ability to swiftly understand the context of a task.
  • Proactive, flexible, and adaptable ("легкий на підйом").
  • Strong problem-solving mindset—focused on finding solutions rather than creating obstacles.
  • This role is intended for local recruitment. Applicants must have the legal right to live and work in Ukraine at the time of application.

IN2 is committed to hiring the best talent. As a company, it is proud of its diverse and inclusive workforce and so we welcome applications from all professional and cultural backgrounds, regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, or religion.

raw.excerpt: Help us shape the future of health technology! At Top Doctors Group, we work to improve the way people access healthcare.
raw.description:
Help us shape the future of health technology!

At Top Doctors Group, we work to improve the way people access healthcare. Through technology, we connect patients, healthcare professionals, and clinics to provide a more accessible, efficient, and human experience.

Today, we operate in 10 countries and develop digital solutions that help thousands of healthcare professionals grow their activity and millions of people find the care they need.

We believe technology creates its greatest impact when it serves people. That is why we continue to grow and look for talented professionals who want to help us build the future of digital health in an international, innovative, and constantly evolving environment.

💡 Why is this role exciting?

Because you will have a direct impact on the development of a complex, cloud-native platform supporting digital health and social care.

iWantGreatCare, part of Top Doctors Group, is a platform that combines Node.js and TypeScript microservices, specialized background workers, event-driven workflows, and applications built with Vue.js and Nuxt.js. It runs on Google Cloud Platform, using technologies such as Pub/Sub, Docker, Kubernetes, MongoDB, BigQuery, ETLs, and modern CI/CD practices.

As a Fullstack Developer, you will design, build, and evolve scalable backend services, distributed workflows, and user-facing applications. You will work closely with Engineering, Product, Design, Operations, Integrations, and DevOps to deliver reliable solutions with a meaningful real-world impact.

⚙️ About the platform

Our platform has a distributed, cloud-native architecture composed of:

  • Microservices and workers: Node.js and TypeScript services, with specialized background workers communicating through GCP Pub/Sub queues and REST APIs.

  • Cloud infrastructure: Google Cloud Platform, Docker, Kubernetes, and managed services supporting scalability and resilience.

  • Data: MongoDB, BigQuery, ETL processes, and integrations with other products and systems.

  • Frontend applications: Administrative and user-facing applications developed with Vue.js and Nuxt.js.

  • DevOps and observability: CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, monitoring, logging, and alerting.

🚀 What you will do

  • Design, build, and evolve Node.js and TypeScript microservices and background workers.

  • Develop queue-based integrations and event-driven workflows using GCP Pub/Sub.

  • Build and improve administrative and user-facing applications with Vue.js and Nuxt.js.

  • Implement robust error handling and strengthen monitoring and alerting across services.

  • Maintain and improve ETL processes and data integrations.

  • Participate in technical planning, estimation, and the delivery of complex features.

  • Work with DevOps to improve CI/CD practices and the platform’s scalability, reliability, and performance.

  • Collaborate with the Integrations team to ensure interoperability across company products.

  • Conduct detailed code reviews and help maintain high standards of code quality.

  • Share knowledge and contribute to the continuous improvement of the team’s engineering practices.

👀 We would love to meet you if…

✔ Proven experience designing or working with distributed systems.

✔ Strong expertise in Node.js and TypeScript, as well as experience with typed programming languages.

✔ Solid knowledge of microservices, background workers, asynchronous processing, and event-driven architectures.

✔ Experience with Google Cloud Platform services such as Pub/Sub, Cloud Functions, Kubernetes, and IAM.

✔ A good understanding of Docker, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and modern DevOps practices.

✔ Experience working with MongoDB, data integrations, and ETL processes.

✔ The ability to use AI coding tools, such as Cursor or Claude Code, to improve productivity while applying strong technical judgment to review, refine, and validate AI-generated code.

✔ A strong commitment to code quality, maintainability, observability, and system reliability.

✔ Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a strong level of English.

➕ Experience with Vue.js, Nuxt.js, BigQuery, or user-facing applications will be a plus.

💙 What you will find

  • 📈 Real opportunities for professional growth and development.

  • 💻 Remote working model in Spain.

  • 🕑 Full-time schedule from Monday to Thursday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:30 p.m., and Fridays from 9:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m.

  • 💰 Gross annual salary between 29.000€ and €33.000€.

  • 🎂 Your birthday off.

  • 💱 Flexible compensation and employee benefits.

  • 🏥 Healthcare discounts.

  • 🌎 An international, dynamic, and collaborative environment.

  • 👥 Leaders who prioritize support, autonomy, and people development.

  • 🥳 A team where you can learn, grow, and enjoy the journey.

🌱 Diversity and inclusion

At Top Doctors Group, we believe that diverse experiences, perspectives, and backgrounds help us build stronger teams and better solutions. We work to create a diverse and inclusive environment where everyone has equal opportunities to develop professionally.

If you require any adjustments or support during the recruitment process, we will be happy to help.

🚀 Interested?

If you have made it this far and identify with much of what we are looking for, we would love to meet you.

We do not believe in perfect applications or candidates who match 100% of the requirements on paper. Beyond specific experience, we value the skills, capabilities, and ways of working that enable people to contribute to the team and support the company’s growth.

If you believe this opportunity could be a good fit for you, apply now!

Why Bixal?

Bixal is a consulting company headquartered in Fairfax, VA, working alongside governments and organizations to help them deliver better services and experiences to the communities they serve. Using evidence-based knowledge and technology, Bixal empowers clients to deliver on their missions more effectively by fostering a culture of learning and continuous improvement.

Our values:

  • People-First: Emphasizing the importance of people in all aspects of work.

  • Collaboration and Transparency: Valuing teamwork and open communication.

  • Growth Mindset: Encouraging innovation and continuous improvement.

  • Creating Lasting Impact: Focusing on meaningful outcomes and positive change.

About the role:

Bixal is seeking an experienced Technical Lead to guide the design, development, and delivery of an enterprise-scale, accessible digital platform for a federal government client. This role combines hands-on technical leadership with day-to-day client engagement, driving architecture decisions across WordPress, Drupal, and Salesforce, and API implementations that support these and other business functions, while mentoring a cross-functional delivery team.

You will work closely with the Project Manager, product owners, designers, and fellow engineers to mature and modernize the platform, ensuring every release meets rigorous accessibility, security, and performance standards. In close collaboration with the Project Manager, you will lead and engage the client – bringing technical judgement, translating complex technical tradeoffs into clear, confident conversations that build trust and keep delivery on track.

Candidates should be prepared to discuss or demonstrate relevant project experience during the interview process.You will have the opportunity to join a project that directly supports Bixal’s mission of improving how government serves people.

Location

This role can work remotely from anywhere in the USA. You must be legally authorized to work in the US.  Bixal does not provide visa sponsorship.

Compensation:

This is a full-time role with a salary range of $135,000 – $155,000. In the spirit of transparency, most offers tend to land near the midpoint of the range. We make compensation decisions thoughtfully, considering your experience, the skills you bring, and our commitment to internal equity. Fairness and transparency are core to how we operate.

Responsibilities:

Technical Leadership

  • Lead architecture and implementation decisions across WordPress, Drupal, and Salesforce, along with API design and integration work connecting these systems.

  • Guide the team in maturing legacy and evolving platforms into modern, enterprise-grade, scalable systems.

  • Set and enforce coding standards, review architecture and code, and drive continuous improvement of technical practices.

  • Ensure development and design work meets accessibility standards (Section 508, WCAG 2.1) across the platform.

  • Partner with DevSecOps and infrastructure teams to maintain secure, reliable, well-documented systems.

Client & Stakeholder Communication

  • Build and maintain trusted, collaborative relationships with client stakeholders, project sponsors, and cross-functional partners.

  • Lead release planning and prioritization by listening to stakeholder input, bringing a clear vision for the solution, and guiding the team toward scope, sequence, and tradeoffs that move the platform forward.

  • Represent the team in client meetings, technical reviews, and planning sessions with polish and confidence, proactively surfacing risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations to keep the client informed and engaged.

Team Leadership & Mentorship

  • Support other technical and delivery activities as needed to keep the platform on track.

  • Bachelor's degree plus at least five (5) years of relevant professional experience in software development or technical leadership; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • At least five (5) years leading or performing on contracts/projects of similar size, scope, and complexity.

  • Experience migrating or consolidating content management platforms, including hands-on work with WordPress and Drupal - theming, custom module/plugin development, and content architecture.

  • Proven experience designing, building, and integrating RESTful APIs across multiple systems and platforms.

  • Experience evaluating and integrating third-party plugins, extensions, and commercial solutions to extend platform capabilities, with sound judgement about when an existing tool meets the need versus when custom development is warranted

  • Demonstrated experience working within enterprise environments and maturing or modernizing existing platforms.

  • Strong understanding of accessible development and design practices (Section 508, WCAG 2.1).

  • Proven track record leading technical teams, with strong mentorship and team-building skills.

  • Polished, confident communication skills, with demonstrated experience presenting to and building relationships with clients and executive stakeholders.

  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments.

    This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a favorable Public Trust determination in support of a federal government contract.

raw.description:
Senior Manager, SEO & GEO

Search Engine Optimization & Generative Engine Optimization | Parallels

Push the boundaries of discovery. In your sweatpants.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Manager of SEO & GEO to lead the next evolution of organic discovery at Parallels.

This role will own our strategy across both traditional search engines and emerging AI-powered discovery platforms. SEO remains a critical growth engine for Parallels - driving visibility, qualified traffic, customer acquisition, and category authority. At the same time, discovery is rapidly expanding into generative AI experiences, where customers increasingly ask tools like ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, and Copilot what to buy, how to solve problems, and which products to trust.

The Senior Manager of SEO & GEO will ensure Parallels continues to win in search today while building a leadership position in the AI-driven discovery channels of tomorrow.

This is a strategic, hands-on leadership role for someone who has deep SEO expertise and is excited to define the emerging GEO playbook. You will strengthen our technical SEO foundation, scale our content and authority strategy, and lead the company approach to improving how Parallels is surfaced, summarized, cited, compared, and recommended by AI-powered platforms.

You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Product Marketing, Sales, Analytics, Communications, and Channel teams to make Parallels more discoverable across the full customer journey - from traditional search queries to AI-generated recommendations.

Your team is global and works across multiple time zones, so comfort with remote work and asynchronous collaboration is critical. Understanding the virtualization space, developer ecosystem, Apple ecosystem, enterprise productivity landscape, and partner routes-to-market will be a strong advantage.

Why This Role Matters

Search is not going away. It remains one of the most important ways customers discover, compare, and choose technology products.

But search is changing.

Customers are increasingly moving from keyword searches to AI-assisted recommendations, conversational answers, and generated product comparisons. That makes SEO more important, not less - because strong technical foundations, authoritative content, structured knowledge, and trusted third-party signals are also what help AI systems understand and recommend a brand.

This role exists to help Parallels win across both dimensions: the proven SEO channels that drive growth today and the emerging GEO channels that will shape customer discovery tomorrow.

What You Will Do

Lead the Integrated SEO & GEO Strategy

  • Own Parallels global organic discovery strategy across traditional search engines and AI-powered discovery platforms.
  • Set the roadmap for SEO and GEO initiatives tied to measurable business outcomes, including qualified traffic, conversion, pipeline influence, brand authority, and AI search visibility.
  • Balance near-term SEO performance with long-term GEO leadership as discovery behavior evolves.
  • Establish Parallels operating model for how SEO, GEO, Product Marketing, Content, Engineering, PR, Channel, and Analytics work together.
  • Lead prioritization, planning, reporting, and executive communication for SEO and GEO initiatives.

Build Parallels GEO Leadership

  • Define and operationalize Parallels Generative Engine Optimization strategy.
  • Improve how Parallels products are surfaced, summarized, cited, compared, and recommended in AI-powered discovery experiences.
  • Monitor Parallels presence across ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Copilot, and emerging AI assistants.
  • Build strategies around entity authority, semantic relevance, structured knowledge, citation visibility, AI retrievability, and recommendation share-of-voice.
  • Partner with Product Marketing and Communications to increase high-quality third-party mentions, citations, and category authority.
  • Develop practical measurement frameworks for GEO where attribution is still evolving.
  • Identify how AI-driven discovery is changing customer journeys, competitive positioning, and purchase consideration.

Strengthen SEO as a Core Growth Engine

  • Lead technical SEO across crawlability, indexing, rendering, site architecture, Core Web Vitals, internal linking, structured data, and international SEO.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to ensure SEO requirements are embedded into product launches, site changes, and platform decisions.
  • Drive content SEO strategy across priority audiences including prosumers, developers, power users, gamers, small and mid-size businesses, enterprise buyers, and channel partners.
  • Improve organic acquisition through better intent mapping, content quality, conversion pathways, and authority building.
  • Ensure Parallels continues to perform strongly in traditional search while preparing for the future of AI-mediated discovery.
  • Diagnose and resolve SEO performance issues across large-scale web properties.

Drive Content, Authority & Discoverability

  • Partner with Product Marketing to translate product capabilities, launches, roadmap themes, and use cases into discoverable narratives.
  • Build topic authority across virtualization, Windows on Mac, Apple enterprise adoption, developer workflows, gaming, productivity, managed devices, and cross-platform work.
  • Create content and information architecture that serves both human buyers and AI retrieval systems.
  • Support digital PR and partner/channel content strategies that increase trusted references to Parallels across the web.
  • Use AI tools responsibly to accelerate research, content optimization, competitive analysis, and workflow efficiency.
  • Help simplify complex technical messages into clear, compelling stories for customers, partners, and search/discovery platforms.

Lead Measurement, Experimentation & Executive Communication

  • Define clear KPIs for both SEO and GEO, including traffic, rankings, conversions, technical health, content performance, brand visibility, AI citations, and recommendation presence.
  • Build test-and-learn frameworks for GEO experiments.
  • Translate complex changes in search and AI discovery into clear business implications for executives.
  • Use data to prioritize investments and communicate progress, risks, and opportunities.
  • Manage SEO/GEO tools, vendors, agencies, and reporting systems as needed.

What You Bring

Required

  • 6+ years leading SEO, organic growth, search strategy, or discoverability programs.
  • Deep technical SEO expertise with a proven record of improving organic growth at scale.
  • Strong understanding of content strategy, authority building, information architecture, and search intent.
  • Demonstrated curiosity and practical experience with AI-driven discovery, GEO, LLM-powered search, or emerging search experiences.
  • Ability to define a new discipline while continuing to operate and improve a mature SEO function.
  • Experience influencing Product, Engineering, Product Marketing, Content, Analytics, Communications, and executive stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort building reporting frameworks where measurement is imperfect.
  • Excellent communication skills with both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Hands-on familiarity with enterprise SEO and analytics tools such as Google Search Console, GA4, Looker/Tableau, Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, Botify, Conductor, BrightEdge, Similarweb, or comparable platforms.
  • Strong project management skills and ability to manage multiple initiatives across teams and time zones.

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience in SaaS, developer tools, virtualization, enterprise productivity, managed devices, or infrastructure technology.
  • Understanding of Apple, Windows, Mac, developer, SMB, enterprise, and partner/channel ecosystems.
  • Familiarity with semantic search, entity optimization, structured data, knowledge graphs, retrieval systems, and AI citation behavior.
  • Experience working with GEO tools that monitor AI search visibility, brand mentions, citations, and recommendation share-of-voice across platforms such as ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, and Copilot.
  • Experience using modern AI tools for research, content analysis, workflow automation, and experimentation.
  • Experience managing agencies, vendors, or distributed teams.
  • Comfort working in a global, remote-first environment with asynchronous collaboration.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 12 months, this leader will:

  • Maintain and improve SEO performance as a major organic acquisition channel.
  • Establish a clear GEO strategy, measurement model, and operating rhythm.
  • Improve Parallels visibility and recommendation presence across AI-powered discovery platforms.
  • Strengthen technical SEO foundations and content authority across priority product and audience segments.
  • Build durable collaboration between SEO, GEO, Product Marketing, Engineering, Content, Communications, Channel, and Analytics.
  • Create a repeatable experimentation framework for AI-driven discovery.
  • Position Parallels to win as traditional search and AI-driven discovery continue to converge.

About Parallels

Parallels is a global leader in cross-platform solutions, enabling businesses and individuals to access and use the applications, files, and workflows they need on any device or operating system.

Parallels helps customers get the best out of the technology they choose - whether that is Windows, Linux, macOS, ChromeOS, iOS, Android, or the cloud. Our products serve individuals, developers, power users, small and mid-size businesses, enterprises, public sector organizations, and educators who need simple, reliable, and cost-effective ways to work across platforms.

Parallels is best known for making complex technology feel simple. We solve deep engineering and user-experience challenges so customers can run the applications they need, where and how they need them - from Windows on Mac to managed enterprise environments and flexible hybrid work setups.

We have millions of users globally and decades of innovation behind us. Today, Parallels is focused on helping customers stay productive in a world where work happens across devices, operating systems, clouds, and increasingly AI-powered workflows.

We offer a fully remote workspace and flexible hours because we believe great work can happen anywhere. Our team is global, collaborative, and built around motivated people who care about solving meaningful customer problems.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Parallels is committed to building an inclusive, barrier-free recruitment and selection process and work environment. We offer equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, age, religion, national origin, sex, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, veteran status, genetics, or any other protected characteristic.

If you are contacted for a job opportunity, please advise us of any accommodations required during the recruitment process. Appropriate accommodations will be provided upon request as required by applicable law and company policy. Any information received relating to accommodations will be treated as confidential.

This is a full-time position contingent on contract award by our client, with a defined performance period of one year with two one-year option periods. This role offers you a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a project that aligns with Bixal’s mission of delivering innovative, human-centered solutions. While the role has a fixed duration, we are committed to transparency and collaboration, keeping you informed about contract updates and new opportunities. At Bixal, we support your professional journey, ensuring your experience reflects our inclusive, purpose-driven culture and prepares you for future success.

Location

This role can work remotely from anywhere in the USA. You must be legally authorized to work in the US.  Bixal does not provide visa sponsorship.

Compensation:

  • Establish SEO baseline metrics and KPIs and report progress against targets on an ongoing basis.

  • Analyze search engine visibility, user behavior, conversion rates, and technical SEO health (e.g., page load speed, crawl/site errors), driving continuous optimization based on findings.
