About Bixal

Bixal is a mission-driven organization that partners with leading federal agencies to design and deliver people-centered digital solutions. We are a diverse group of strategists, designers, technologists, and data scientists who believe in using design and technology to make government services more accessible and effective for all.

Independent Consultant Opportunity

Opportunity Overview

Bixal supports a large, federally funded public information and communications program that serves families and professionals across the country. The program's digital ecosystem includes a high-traffic public website, mobile applications, an online professional community, and a customer support center, reaching millions of visitors each year. A significant share of the audience is Spanish-speaking, and the program is committed to delivering accurate, high-quality, and culturally responsive information in both English and Spanish across every channel.

Bixal is seeking a detail-oriented, culturally fluent Spanish Content Translator to support this program. This role is central to ensuring Spanish-speaking users receive the same high-quality, accurate, and accessible information as English-speaking users. This is a part-time position at 50% allocation, ideal for an experienced translator who wants steady, meaningful work supporting a high-visibility public-facing platform.

As a 1099 independent contractor, you will operate independently, provide your own tools, set your own hours, and invoice Bixal for completed work.

Compensation

The compensation for this role is $50 an hour. We make compensation decisions thoughtfully, considering your experience, the skills you bring, and our commitment to internal equity. Fairness and transparency are core to how we operate.

Key Responsibilities

  • Produce high-quality Spanish translations of website content, including web pages, PDFs, video captions/subtitles, and learning modules, working within a translation management platform.

  • Maintain and continuously improve a glossary of terms to ensure consistent terminology and translation quality across all program digital properties.

  • Provide live simultaneous Spanish interpretation for webinars and webcasts throughout the year, with audiences ranging from the hundreds to several thousand participants.

  • Translate and review Spanish-language content for email campaigns, social media, and the customer service center's public-facing responses and knowledge base.

  • Partner with the UX research team to support usability testing, interviews, and surveys with Spanish-speaking users, ensuring translated materials are tested for clarity and cultural relevance.

  • Review translated content for compliance with plain-language standards and accessibility requirements.

  • Collaborate with content strategists, designers, and engineers to ensure translated materials are published accurately and on schedule.

  • Perform other duties as required.

Required Qualifications

  • Native or professional-level fluency in both Spanish and English (written and spoken), with demonstrated translation and interpretation experience.

  • Professional translation or interpretation certification preferred (e.g., ATA certification or equivalent).

  • Experience with translation management systems (e.g., Lingotek or similar) strongly preferred.

  • Prior experience providing live/simultaneous interpretation for webinars, conferences, or public events.

  • Strong writing skills with close attention to accuracy, tone, and cultural nuance.

  • Familiarity with plain-language and accessibility standards is a plus.

  • Experience translating content for a government or public-sector client is a plus.

  • Bachelor's degree in translation, linguistics, communications, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a favorable Public Trust determination in support of a federal government contract.

Important Notes

  • This is a 1099 consulting opportunity, not a full-time or part-time employment position.

  • Bixal does not provide benefits or equipment for independent contractors.

  • All applicants must reside in and be authorized to work in the United States.

  • Review content within the CMS for clarity, findability, accessibility, and usability, recommending structural, navigational, or governance improvements informed by data and user needs.

  • Establish and document information-architecture standards and permissions structures that support consistent content governance and auditability.

  • Ensure content structure and metadata remain consistent across distribution channels and rendering formats during publishing.

  • Design and participate in usability testing, contributing IA-specific test scenarios (e.g., card sorting, tree testing, navigation tasks) and translating findings into structural recommendations.

  • Partner with SEO and digital strategy teams on keyword-informed taxonomy and site-structure decisions that support both user experience and organic search performance.

  • Support development of journey maps tied to specific audience events or milestones to identify structural and content gaps.

Qualifications:

  • BA in Communications, English, Information Science, Technical Communication, or UX Writing.

  • Minimum 6 years of experience in content strategy, information architecture, or UX-focused content work, ideally within a large public-facing website or application environment.

  • Demonstrated experience building taxonomies, sitemaps, content models, and/or metadata frameworks.

  • Experience developing personas, journey maps, and other user-research-informed strategy artifacts.

  • Familiarity with usability testing methods (e.g., card sorting, tree testing, moderated user testing) and translating findings into actionable structural recommendations.

At Bixal, we want to ensure a transparent and secure application process for all candidates. Official communication will come from an email address ending in @bixal.com or from @bixal.na.teamtailor-mail.com. Bixal will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

Need Assistance or a Reasonable Accommodation?If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation to complete your application, we're here to help. Please reach out to us at and let us know how we can support you. You do not need to share personal details or disclose the nature of your request. You can expect a response from a team member within 24 hours during the regular work week and on the next operating day during the weekend or holidays.

Why Bixal?

Bixal is a consulting company headquartered in Fairfax, VA, working alongside governments and organizations to help them deliver better services and experiences to the communities they serve. Using evidence-based knowledge and technology, Bixal empowers clients to deliver on their missions more effectively by fostering a culture of learning and continuous improvement.

Our values:

  • People-First: Emphasizing the importance of people in all aspects of work.

  • Collaboration and Transparency: Valuing teamwork and open communication.

  • Growth Mindset: Encouraging innovation and continuous improvement.

  • Creating Lasting Impact: Focusing on meaningful outcomes and positive change.

About the role:

Bixal is building a pipeline of qualified subject matter experts (SMEs) to support anti-human trafficking training and technical assistance (T/TA). Selected experts may be engaged on a short-term, part-time basis to design training content, advise on and peer review training materials, and deliver training in-person or virtually.

Please read carefully before applying:

This is a call for experts to join a talent pipeline. By applying, you are asking to have your resume reviewed and, if appropriate, added to a consultant database for future consideration.

  • If you apply, you will receive a confirmation email acknowledging that your application was received.

  • Your resume will then be reviewed and may be added to our consultant pipeline.

  • Applicant contact depends on alignment with the role. You will be contacted only if a specific project arises in 2027 for which your experience is a strong fit.

  • Joining our talent pipeline doesn't guarantee a project or assignment, and there's no obligation for either you or Bixal. If an opportunity aligns with your background, we'll be in touch.

  • Any potential work would be short-term and part-time (for example, designing the content for a single training, advising on one curriculum, or delivering one training session). Assignments are discrete and time-limited; they are not ongoing or full-time roles.

  • Availability, timing, and volume of work in 2027 depend entirely on project needs.

Compensation:

The compensation rate is expected to be $100 – $200/hour, depending on scope of work.

What Selected Consultants May Be Asked to Do:

Depending on the specific project need, engaged consultants may be asked to do one or more of the following on a short-term basis:

  • Design and develop training content and materials — for example, curricula, Training-of-Trainers (ToT) manuals, toolkits, micro-learnings, fact sheets, workbooks, desk guides, and screening tools — aligned with adult-learning principles and suited to in-person, virtual, and self-directed formats.

  • Advise on and review training content, including serving as a peer reviewer to assess the accuracy, relevance, and quality of materials.

  • Deliver training in person or virtually, including interactive sessions with case-based problem-solving and Q&A.

  • Update or adapt existing training content to reflect current best practices, terminology, and field needs.

Minimum Qualifications to apply:

  • Bachelor's degree.

  • At least 8 years of professional experience working in the anti-human trafficking space.

  • Recognized subject matter expertise in one or more areas of anti-human trafficking — for example, victim identification and response, prevention, case management, trauma-informed care, labor or sex trafficking, tech-facilitated exploitation, or clinical/healthcare response.

  • Experience developing and/or delivering training or educational content in the anti-human trafficking space, or comparable experience translating subject matter expertise into materials, presentations, or capacity-building for professional audiences.

  • Working knowledge of trauma-informed, person-centered approaches to human trafficking.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Familiarity with the SOAR (Stop, Observe, Ask, Respond) framework or comparable public-health approaches to human trafficking.

Our company is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all individuals and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local anti-discrimination laws. Employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.

About the role:

Bixal is seeking a Knowledge Management Specialist, Digital Support Operations to help keep a large public-facing federal digital program running smoothly and well documented. You will provide Tier 2 support across a portfolio of websites and applications, manage the queue where program questions and issues arrive, document the business processes the support operation runs on, and establish the process for communicating with users when a service is disrupted. It suits someone who would rather fix the process that generated fifty tickets than close them one at a time.

The program supports a large and diverse community through a broad portfolio of public websites, applications, and learning platforms. When a program question comes in, an interface breaks, or a service goes down, the quality of the response depends on the processes, documentation, and knowledge behind the support operation.

This project supports a large-scale outreach and engagement effort, delivering strategic communications, content and creative services, digital strategy, and audience engagement across public-facing websites, applications, and social media platforms. The work is paired with the IT, cybersecurity, and data operations needed to keep that digital presence secure, reliable, and available around the clock. The program's mission is to ensure the intended audience receives timely, accurate, and accessible information about the programs, services, and policies that affect them with content and platforms built to scale, adapt to changing needs, and hold up to federal compliance and security standards.

This is a full-time position contingent on contract award by our client, with a defined performance period of one year with two one-year option periods. This role offers you a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a project that aligns with Bixal’s mission of delivering innovative, human-centered solutions. While the role has a fixed duration, we are committed to transparency and collaboration, keeping you informed about contract updates and new opportunities. At Bixal, we support your professional journey, ensuring your experience reflects our inclusive, purpose-driven culture and prepares you for future success.

Location

This role can work remotely from anywhere in the USA. You must be legally authorized to work in the US.  Bixal does not provide visa sponsorship.

Compensation:

The salary range for this role is $77,000 – $87,000. In the spirit of transparency, most offers tend to land near the midpoint of the range. We make compensation decisions thoughtfully, considering your experience, the skills you bring, and our commitment to internal equity. Fairness and transparency are core to how we operate.

Responsibilities:

Support & Service Operations

  • Provide Tier 2 support for online resources, website/interface issues, and program questions.

  • Manage the user request and inquiry queue, including acknowledgment, routing, tracking, and closure.

  • Monitor key digital pages, tools, and functions daily and escalate issues.

  • Maintain the service outage and interruption notification process and keep support content aligned with active incidents.

Process & Knowledge Management

  • Develop and document standardized business processes for staff portals, help desk operations, and user messaging workflows.

  • Run and maintain the link-vetting program, including reviews, SOPs, approvals, reporting, and replacement recommendations.

  • Train staff to submit, use, and maintain knowledge and content.

Content Quality, Findability & Publishing

  • Perform technical editing and proofreading against program standards, AP style, and federal plain-language requirements.

  • Coordinate with information architecture and search specialists on metadata, categorization, retrieval, reuse, tracking, and routing.

  • Contribute to digital publishing operations, including the editorial calendar, recurring publications/newsletters, subscriptions, and audits.

  • Partner with search specialists on staff education around search, findability, and content standards.

Measurement & Continuous Improvement

  • Build and maintain the Tier 2 customer support satisfaction dashboard.

  • Analyze recurring issues, trends, and topics.

  • Translate support data into process improvements and self-service content.

  • Other relevant duties as qualified/trained to perform

Qualifications:

  • Active Secret clearance. An interim Secret is acceptable to start.

  • Bachelor's degree, or equivalent professional experience.

  • At least 4 years in knowledge management, technical writing, documentation development, content operations, or customer support operations.

  • Hands-on experience with an enterprise knowledge base, documentation platform, or content management system.

  • Experience providing tiered customer or program support, working to defined acknowledgment and routing timeframes with a ticketing or case management system, and familiarity with ITIL practices for knowledge management, incident, problem and change.

  • Experience documenting business processes and standard operating procedures used by an operational team.

  • Experience with incident or service-disruption communications — the processes, severity definitions and notice templates that govern how users are told something is broken.

  • Demonstrated ability to draw knowledge out of subject-matter experts, interviewing program and technical staff and turning what they know into documentation someone else can follow.

  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex technical or policy material into clear, plain-language content that a non-specialist can act on.

Nice to Have Skills and Experience:

  • ITIL v4 Foundation certification, or willingness to obtain it within 90 days of start.

  • Experience supporting a federal or DoD program, particularly in outreach, communications, or public-facing digital services.

  • Strong editing skills — you can take someone else's draft and make it correct, clear and consistent with a style guide, whether AP or a house guide.

  • Experience turning support or content performance data into reporting that actually changed a process.

  • Experience with enterprise email or subscription publishing platforms.

  • Experience developing training materials and delivering workshops to staff audiences.

How We Support Our Team:

  • Flex hours

  • 401K with matching incentive

  • Parental Leave

  • Medical/dental/vision benefits

  • Flex Spending Account

  • Company provided short-term disability and life insurance

  • Commuter benefits

  • Paid Time Off (PTO)

  • 11 Paid holidays

Our company is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all individuals and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local anti-discrimination laws. Employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.

Serás una de las figuras técnicas clave en el diseño, evolución y escalabilidad de una plataforma tecnológica avanzada, participando desde las decisiones de arquitectura hasta la implementación de soluciones en producción.

Trabajarás en un entorno donde convergen inteligencia artificial, sistemas distribuidos, infraestructura cloud, gestión del conocimiento y arquitecturas orientadas a eventos.

  • Diseñar y desarrollar soluciones escalables para entornos empresariales complejos.

  • Participar en decisiones de arquitectura y evolución tecnológica del producto.

  • Liderar iniciativas técnicas de alto impacto.

  • Contribuir al desarrollo de plataformas basadas en inteligencia artificial y automatización avanzada.

  • Colaborar en la definición de estándares técnicos, buenas prácticas y procesos de ingeniería.

  • Participar activamente en el desarrollo, revisión y despliegue de código.

Qué buscamos

  • Experiencia consolidada en posiciones Senior, Staff o Principal Engineer.

  • Trayectoria en el diseño y construcción de sistemas complejos en producción.

  • Capacidad para combinar visión estratégica y ejecución técnica.

  • Experiencia tomando decisiones de arquitectura y liderazgo técnico.

  • Conocimiento de ecosistemas backend modernos, infraestructuras distribuidas y soluciones escalables.

  • Interés por tecnologías relacionadas con inteligencia artificial, automatización avanzada y plataformas de datos.

Valoraremos especialmente

  • Experiencia en plataformas B2B.

  • Desarrollo de sistemas intensivos en datos.

  • Arquitecturas basadas en eventos.

  • Infraestructura y plataformas de IA.

  • Sistemas de conocimiento, grafos u ontologías.

  • Integraciones enterprise.

  • Diseño de workflows complejos y motores de orquestación.

Qué ofrece el proyecto

  • Modalidad 100% remota.

  • Viajes puntuales durante el año para encuentros de equipo y eventos tecnológicos.

  • Seguro médico privado.

  • Participación en un producto tecnológico propio en plena evolución.

  • Acceso a herramientas de IA e infraestructura avanzada para investigación y desarrollo.

  • Asistencia a eventos y congresos tecnológicos de referencia.

  • Entorno altamente técnico, colaborativo y orientado a la innovación.

  • Posibilidad de influir directamente en las decisiones de producto y arquitectura desde fases tempranas.

  • Proyecto estable con recorrido y capacidad real de crecimiento profesional.

  • Banda salarial orientativa entre 35.000 € y 55.000 € brutos anuales, valorándose especialmente la experiencia y conocimientos aportados.

Si buscas un proyecto donde participar en la construcción de tecnología con impacto, asumir retos de arquitectura y formar parte de un equipo altamente especializado, estaremos encantados de conocerte.

raw.excerpt: About IN2IN2 is an award-winning specialist communications, development, and research company dedicated to creating positive change for communities in rapidly changing environments.
raw.description:
About IN2

IN2 is an award-winning specialist communications, development, and research company dedicated to creating positive change for communities in rapidly changing environments. We use innovative and engaging two-way communications to create impact across the full spectrum of geo-political and socio-economic issues, including global security, international development, business transformation, and climate change.

IN2 combines a global geopolitical outlook with a rich understanding of local grassroots sentiment to help clients develop, deliver, and measure engagement campaigns that connect our clients with their intended audiences in a language, manner, and medium that feels natural to them.

With our track record of delivering culturally sensitive campaigns in challenging and higher-risk environments around the world, IN2 has become a trusted partner and advisor to a range of clients from national governments and transnational institutions to global brands and international NGOs.

IN2 has offices in the UK, UAE, Jordan, Iraq, Poland, and Kenya.

IN2’s professionally and culturally diverse 180-strong staff hail from 20 countries. We are committed to diversity in our workplace.

Operations & Project Coordinator

We are looking for a proactive, versatile, and problem-solving Operations & Project Coordinator to act as the right hand to the Country Manager of IN2 in Ukraine.

In this role, you will help streamline internal country operations, support the execution of specific projects, and assist with business development efforts (including bid writing) and project evaluation (MEL). This is a dynamic role designed for someone who can quickly grasp the context of a task, work independently, and relieve the Country Manager’s workload by driving specific assignments forward.

This position is offered on a fixed-term basis until 30 April 2027, with the potential for extension depending on project needs.

Responsibilities:

  • Operational Coordination: Assist in optimizing workflows, managing internal documentation, and streamlining communications across country operations.
  • Task Execution: Take charge of specific, targeted tasks within ongoing projects as assigned by the Country Manager.
  • Follow-ups & Tracking: Track project deadlines, milestones, and action items to ensure smooth project implementation.
  • Proposal Writing: Assist in drafting, editing, and assembling high-quality project proposals, concepts, and bids for international donors.
  • Market & Donor Tracking: Help monitor funding opportunities, donor pipelines, and open tenders in Ukraine.
  • Documentation Prep: Prepare necessary institutional documents and background materials for upcoming bids.
  • Data Collection: Support the gathering of qualitative and quantitative data from project sites or partners.
  • Reporting Assistance: Help draft clear, data-driven progress reports for donors and internal stakeholders based on established MEL indicators.
  • Tracking Logs: Maintain update logs and spreadsheets related to project performance and lessons learned.

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in project coordination, administration, or business development.
  • Prior experience working within international development projects, humanitarian organizations, INGOs, or collaborating with Ukrainian state institutions/ministries.
  • Practical experience in assisting with grant/proposal writing and a solid understanding of monitoring and evaluation concepts (KPIs, logical frameworks).
  • Practical understanding of how international donors (e.g., USAID, EU, UN agencies) operate.
  • Advanced English and Ukrainian (both written and spoken) are required, as you will be drafting parts of proposals and reports in English.
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of tasks.
  • Quick learner with the ability to swiftly understand the context of a task.
  • Proactive, flexible, and adaptable ("легкий на підйом").
  • Strong problem-solving mindset—focused on finding solutions rather than creating obstacles.
  • This role is intended for local recruitment. Applicants must have the legal right to live and work in Ukraine at the time of application.

IN2 is committed to hiring the best talent. As a company, it is proud of its diverse and inclusive workforce and so we welcome applications from all professional and cultural backgrounds, regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, or religion.

raw.description:
Help us shape the future of health technology!

At Top Doctors Group, we work to improve the way people access healthcare. Through technology, we connect patients, healthcare professionals, and clinics to provide a more accessible, efficient, and human experience.

Today, we operate in 10 countries and develop digital solutions that help thousands of healthcare professionals grow their activity and millions of people find the care they need.

We believe technology creates its greatest impact when it serves people. That is why we continue to grow and look for talented professionals who want to help us build the future of digital health in an international, innovative, and constantly evolving environment.

💡 Why is this role exciting?

Because you will have a direct impact on the development of a complex, cloud-native platform supporting digital health and social care.

iWantGreatCare, part of Top Doctors Group, is a platform that combines Node.js and TypeScript microservices, specialized background workers, event-driven workflows, and applications built with Vue.js and Nuxt.js. It runs on Google Cloud Platform, using technologies such as Pub/Sub, Docker, Kubernetes, MongoDB, BigQuery, ETLs, and modern CI/CD practices.

As a Fullstack Developer, you will design, build, and evolve scalable backend services, distributed workflows, and user-facing applications. You will work closely with Engineering, Product, Design, Operations, Integrations, and DevOps to deliver reliable solutions with a meaningful real-world impact.

⚙️ About the platform

Our platform has a distributed, cloud-native architecture composed of:

  • Microservices and workers: Node.js and TypeScript services, with specialized background workers communicating through GCP Pub/Sub queues and REST APIs.

  • Cloud infrastructure: Google Cloud Platform, Docker, Kubernetes, and managed services supporting scalability and resilience.

  • Data: MongoDB, BigQuery, ETL processes, and integrations with other products and systems.

  • Frontend applications: Administrative and user-facing applications developed with Vue.js and Nuxt.js.

  • DevOps and observability: CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, monitoring, logging, and alerting.

🚀 What you will do

  • Design, build, and evolve Node.js and TypeScript microservices and background workers.

  • Develop queue-based integrations and event-driven workflows using GCP Pub/Sub.

  • Build and improve administrative and user-facing applications with Vue.js and Nuxt.js.

  • Implement robust error handling and strengthen monitoring and alerting across services.

  • Maintain and improve ETL processes and data integrations.

  • Participate in technical planning, estimation, and the delivery of complex features.

  • Work with DevOps to improve CI/CD practices and the platform’s scalability, reliability, and performance.

  • Collaborate with the Integrations team to ensure interoperability across company products.

  • Conduct detailed code reviews and help maintain high standards of code quality.

  • Share knowledge and contribute to the continuous improvement of the team’s engineering practices.

👀 We would love to meet you if…

✔ Proven experience designing or working with distributed systems.

✔ Strong expertise in Node.js and TypeScript, as well as experience with typed programming languages.

✔ Solid knowledge of microservices, background workers, asynchronous processing, and event-driven architectures.

✔ Experience with Google Cloud Platform services such as Pub/Sub, Cloud Functions, Kubernetes, and IAM.

✔ A good understanding of Docker, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and modern DevOps practices.

✔ Experience working with MongoDB, data integrations, and ETL processes.

✔ The ability to use AI coding tools, such as Cursor or Claude Code, to improve productivity while applying strong technical judgment to review, refine, and validate AI-generated code.

✔ A strong commitment to code quality, maintainability, observability, and system reliability.

✔ Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a strong level of English.

➕ Experience with Vue.js, Nuxt.js, BigQuery, or user-facing applications will be a plus.

💙 What you will find

  • 📈 Real opportunities for professional growth and development.

  • 💻 Remote working model in Spain.

  • 🕑 Full-time schedule from Monday to Thursday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:30 p.m., and Fridays from 9:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m.

  • 💰 Gross annual salary between 29.000€ and €33.000€.

  • 🎂 Your birthday off.

  • 💱 Flexible compensation and employee benefits.

  • 🏥 Healthcare discounts.

  • 🌎 An international, dynamic, and collaborative environment.

  • 👥 Leaders who prioritize support, autonomy, and people development.

  • 🥳 A team where you can learn, grow, and enjoy the journey.

🌱 Diversity and inclusion

At Top Doctors Group, we believe that diverse experiences, perspectives, and backgrounds help us build stronger teams and better solutions. We work to create a diverse and inclusive environment where everyone has equal opportunities to develop professionally.

If you require any adjustments or support during the recruitment process, we will be happy to help.

🚀 Interested?

If you have made it this far and identify with much of what we are looking for, we would love to meet you.

We do not believe in perfect applications or candidates who match 100% of the requirements on paper. Beyond specific experience, we value the skills, capabilities, and ways of working that enable people to contribute to the team and support the company’s growth.

If you believe this opportunity could be a good fit for you, apply now!

Se você tem paixão por inovação e busca trabalhar em um ambiente ágil, colaborativo e desafiador, esta pode ser a sua oportunidade!

Para o nosso time deCanais e Parcerias, buscamos alguém com viés de negócios e tecnologia para expandir nossa presença dentro de plataformas SaaS, ERPs e E-commerces. Sua missão será construir e escalar uma rede de distribuição sólida, conduzindo todo o ciclo de parceria, da prospecção à ativação de integrações via API e ações de co-marketing, com o objetivo de consolidar o Asaas como a principal solução de Embedded Finance e BaaS do mercado, garantindo recorrência e alto valor agregado aos parceiros. Você terá uma rotina dinâmica, dividindo seu tempo entre a prospecção ativa de novos parceiros e a gestão consultiva de uma carteira de parceiros ativos, garantindo o sucesso da integração e da receita transacional.

Se interessou pela oportunidade mas não reside em Joinville? Não tem problema, possibilitamos o trabalho remoto/home office.

  • Mapear, qualificar e prospectar plataformas tecnológicas com alto potencial de integração e distribuição;
  • Conduzir reuniões de alinhamento técnico e comercial com decisores (fundadores, heads de produto, tecnologia e negócios);
  • Criar documentos e materiais de apoio para integração, capacitação e engajamento dos parceiros;
  • Planejar e construir ações em conjunto com os parceiros, com foco no sucesso da parceria (resultados);
  • Negociar modelos de remuneração (CAC + Revenue Share) e condições de parceria com foco em equilíbrio e escala;
  • Coordenar projetos de integração junto ao time técnico do Asaas, atuando como ponte entre produto, engenharia e parceiro;
  • Construir jornadas de onboarding e ativação dos parceiros integradores;
  • Criar campanhas de go-to-market, co-marketing e planos de ativação para maximizar tração e resultados;

  • Monitorar resultados dos parceiros, gerar insights e propor planos de evolução com foco em receita e recorrência;
  • Manter relacionamento contínuo com parceiros ativos e apoiar em eventuais necessidades técnicas ou de produto;
  • Acompanhar benchmarks e tendências do mercado de parcerias tecnológicas (embedded finance, fintechs, open finance);
  • Construir business cases para justificar e priorizar integrações estratégicas com parceiros, considerando impacto em receita, volume e sinergia com o portfólio Asaas.

At Bixal, we want to ensure a transparent and secure application process for all candidates. Bixal will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

Need Assistance or a Reasonable Accommodation?If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation to complete your application, we're here to help. Please reach out to us at and let us know how we can support you. You do not need to share personal details or disclose the nature of your request. You can expect a response from a team member within 24 hours during the regular work week and on the next operating day during the weekend or holidays.

Why Bixal?

Bixal is a consulting company headquartered in Fairfax, VA, working alongside governments and organizations to help them deliver better services and experiences to the communities they serve. Using evidence-based knowledge and technology, Bixal empowers clients to deliver on their missions more effectively by fostering a culture of learning and continuous improvement.

Our values:

  • People-First: Emphasizing the importance of people in all aspects of work.

  • Collaboration and Transparency: Valuing teamwork and open communication.

  • Growth Mindset: Encouraging innovation and continuous improvement.

  • Creating Lasting Impact: Focusing on meaningful outcomes and positive change.

About the role:

Bixal is seeking an experienced Technical Lead to guide the design, development, and delivery of an enterprise-scale, accessible digital platform for a federal government client. This role combines hands-on technical leadership with day-to-day client engagement, driving architecture decisions across WordPress, Drupal, and Salesforce, and API implementations that support these and other business functions, while mentoring a cross-functional delivery team.

You will work closely with the Project Manager, product owners, designers, and fellow engineers to mature and modernize the platform, ensuring every release meets rigorous accessibility, security, and performance standards. In close collaboration with the Project Manager, you will lead and engage the client – bringing technical judgement, translating complex technical tradeoffs into clear, confident conversations that build trust and keep delivery on track.

Candidates should be prepared to discuss or demonstrate relevant project experience during the interview process.You will have the opportunity to join a project that directly supports Bixal’s mission of improving how government serves people.

Location

This role can work remotely from anywhere in the USA. You must be legally authorized to work in the US.  Bixal does not provide visa sponsorship.

Compensation:

This is a full-time role with a salary range of $135,000 – $155,000. In the spirit of transparency, most offers tend to land near the midpoint of the range. We make compensation decisions thoughtfully, considering your experience, the skills you bring, and our commitment to internal equity. Fairness and transparency are core to how we operate.

Responsibilities:

Technical Leadership

  • Lead architecture and implementation decisions across WordPress, Drupal, and Salesforce, along with API design and integration work connecting these systems.

  • Guide the team in maturing legacy and evolving platforms into modern, enterprise-grade, scalable systems.

  • Set and enforce coding standards, review architecture and code, and drive continuous improvement of technical practices.

  • Ensure development and design work meets accessibility standards (Section 508, WCAG 2.1) across the platform.

  • Partner with DevSecOps and infrastructure teams to maintain secure, reliable, well-documented systems.

Client & Stakeholder Communication

  • Supporting the Project Manager as the technical point of contact, communicating complex concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Build and maintain trusted, collaborative relationships with client stakeholders, project sponsors, and cross-functional partners.

  • Lead release planning and prioritization by listening to stakeholder input, bringing a clear vision for the solution, and guiding the team toward scope, sequence, and tradeoffs that move the platform forward.

  • Represent the team in client meetings, technical reviews, and planning sessions with polish and confidence, proactively surfacing risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations to keep the client informed and engaged.

  • Demonstrated ability to build genuine rapport with clients and stakeholders, remaining calm, positive, and collaborative under pressure.

Team Leadership & Mentorship

  • Provide day-to-day technical leadership and mentorship to a cross-functional team of engineers and designers.

  • Foster a collaborative, high-performing team culture grounded in accountability and continuous learning.

  • Guide the team through iterative delivery.

Delivery & Quality

  • Develop the technical roadmap collaboratively with the Project Manager, and contribute to its presentation in client and planning sessions.

  • Drive quality through code reviews, automated testing, and adherence to secure development practices.

  • Identify and resolve technical risks, bottlenecks, and technical debt before they impact delivery.

  • Support other technical and delivery activities as needed to keep the platform on track.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree plus at least five (5) years of relevant professional experience in software development or technical leadership; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • At least five (5) years leading or performing on contracts/projects of similar size, scope, and complexity.

  • Experience migrating or consolidating content management platforms, including hands-on work with WordPress and Drupal - theming, custom module/plugin development, and content architecture.

  • Proven experience designing, building, and integrating RESTful APIs across multiple systems and platforms.

  • Experience evaluating and integrating third-party plugins, extensions, and commercial solutions to extend platform capabilities, with sound judgement about when an existing tool meets the need versus when custom development is warranted

  • Demonstrated experience working within enterprise environments and maturing or modernizing existing platforms.

  • Strong understanding of accessible development and design practices (Section 508, WCAG 2.1).

  • Proven track record leading technical teams, with strong mentorship and team-building skills.

  • Polished, confident communication skills, with demonstrated experience presenting to and building relationships with clients and executive stakeholders.

  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments.

    This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a favorable Public Trust determination in support of a federal government contract.

Nice to Have Skills and Experience:

raw.description:
Senior Manager, SEO & GEO

Search Engine Optimization & Generative Engine Optimization | Parallels

Push the boundaries of discovery. In your sweatpants.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Manager of SEO & GEO to lead the next evolution of organic discovery at Parallels.

This role will own our strategy across both traditional search engines and emerging AI-powered discovery platforms. SEO remains a critical growth engine for Parallels - driving visibility, qualified traffic, customer acquisition, and category authority. At the same time, discovery is rapidly expanding into generative AI experiences, where customers increasingly ask tools like ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, and Copilot what to buy, how to solve problems, and which products to trust.

The Senior Manager of SEO & GEO will ensure Parallels continues to win in search today while building a leadership position in the AI-driven discovery channels of tomorrow.

This is a strategic, hands-on leadership role for someone who has deep SEO expertise and is excited to define the emerging GEO playbook. You will strengthen our technical SEO foundation, scale our content and authority strategy, and lead the company approach to improving how Parallels is surfaced, summarized, cited, compared, and recommended by AI-powered platforms.

You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Product Marketing, Sales, Analytics, Communications, and Channel teams to make Parallels more discoverable across the full customer journey - from traditional search queries to AI-generated recommendations.

Your team is global and works across multiple time zones, so comfort with remote work and asynchronous collaboration is critical. Understanding the virtualization space, developer ecosystem, Apple ecosystem, enterprise productivity landscape, and partner routes-to-market will be a strong advantage.

Why This Role Matters

Search is not going away. It remains one of the most important ways customers discover, compare, and choose technology products.

But search is changing.

Customers are increasingly moving from keyword searches to AI-assisted recommendations, conversational answers, and generated product comparisons. That makes SEO more important, not less - because strong technical foundations, authoritative content, structured knowledge, and trusted third-party signals are also what help AI systems understand and recommend a brand.

This role exists to help Parallels win across both dimensions: the proven SEO channels that drive growth today and the emerging GEO channels that will shape customer discovery tomorrow.

What You Will Do

Lead the Integrated SEO & GEO Strategy

  • Own Parallels global organic discovery strategy across traditional search engines and AI-powered discovery platforms.
  • Set the roadmap for SEO and GEO initiatives tied to measurable business outcomes, including qualified traffic, conversion, pipeline influence, brand authority, and AI search visibility.
  • Balance near-term SEO performance with long-term GEO leadership as discovery behavior evolves.
  • Establish Parallels operating model for how SEO, GEO, Product Marketing, Content, Engineering, PR, Channel, and Analytics work together.
  • Lead prioritization, planning, reporting, and executive communication for SEO and GEO initiatives.

Build Parallels GEO Leadership

  • Define and operationalize Parallels Generative Engine Optimization strategy.
  • Improve how Parallels products are surfaced, summarized, cited, compared, and recommended in AI-powered discovery experiences.
  • Monitor Parallels presence across ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Copilot, and emerging AI assistants.
  • Build strategies around entity authority, semantic relevance, structured knowledge, citation visibility, AI retrievability, and recommendation share-of-voice.
  • Partner with Product Marketing and Communications to increase high-quality third-party mentions, citations, and category authority.
  • Develop practical measurement frameworks for GEO where attribution is still evolving.
  • Identify how AI-driven discovery is changing customer journeys, competitive positioning, and purchase consideration.

Strengthen SEO as a Core Growth Engine

  • Lead technical SEO across crawlability, indexing, rendering, site architecture, Core Web Vitals, internal linking, structured data, and international SEO.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to ensure SEO requirements are embedded into product launches, site changes, and platform decisions.
  • Drive content SEO strategy across priority audiences including prosumers, developers, power users, gamers, small and mid-size businesses, enterprise buyers, and channel partners.
  • Improve organic acquisition through better intent mapping, content quality, conversion pathways, and authority building.
  • Ensure Parallels continues to perform strongly in traditional search while preparing for the future of AI-mediated discovery.
  • Diagnose and resolve SEO performance issues across large-scale web properties.

Drive Content, Authority & Discoverability

  • Partner with Product Marketing to translate product capabilities, launches, roadmap themes, and use cases into discoverable narratives.
  • Build topic authority across virtualization, Windows on Mac, Apple enterprise adoption, developer workflows, gaming, productivity, managed devices, and cross-platform work.
  • Create content and information architecture that serves both human buyers and AI retrieval systems.
  • Support digital PR and partner/channel content strategies that increase trusted references to Parallels across the web.
  • Use AI tools responsibly to accelerate research, content optimization, competitive analysis, and workflow efficiency.
  • Help simplify complex technical messages into clear, compelling stories for customers, partners, and search/discovery platforms.

Lead Measurement, Experimentation & Executive Communication

  • Define clear KPIs for both SEO and GEO, including traffic, rankings, conversions, technical health, content performance, brand visibility, AI citations, and recommendation presence.
  • Build test-and-learn frameworks for GEO experiments.
  • Translate complex changes in search and AI discovery into clear business implications for executives.
  • Use data to prioritize investments and communicate progress, risks, and opportunities.
  • Manage SEO/GEO tools, vendors, agencies, and reporting systems as needed.

What You Bring

Required

  • 6+ years leading SEO, organic growth, search strategy, or discoverability programs.
  • Deep technical SEO expertise with a proven record of improving organic growth at scale.
  • Strong understanding of content strategy, authority building, information architecture, and search intent.
  • Demonstrated curiosity and practical experience with AI-driven discovery, GEO, LLM-powered search, or emerging search experiences.
  • Ability to define a new discipline while continuing to operate and improve a mature SEO function.
  • Experience influencing Product, Engineering, Product Marketing, Content, Analytics, Communications, and executive stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort building reporting frameworks where measurement is imperfect.
  • Excellent communication skills with both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Hands-on familiarity with enterprise SEO and analytics tools such as Google Search Console, GA4, Looker/Tableau, Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, Botify, Conductor, BrightEdge, Similarweb, or comparable platforms.
  • Strong project management skills and ability to manage multiple initiatives across teams and time zones.

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience in SaaS, developer tools, virtualization, enterprise productivity, managed devices, or infrastructure technology.
  • Understanding of Apple, Windows, Mac, developer, SMB, enterprise, and partner/channel ecosystems.
  • Familiarity with semantic search, entity optimization, structured data, knowledge graphs, retrieval systems, and AI citation behavior.
  • Experience working with GEO tools that monitor AI search visibility, brand mentions, citations, and recommendation share-of-voice across platforms such as ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, and Copilot.
  • Experience using modern AI tools for research, content analysis, workflow automation, and experimentation.
  • Experience managing agencies, vendors, or distributed teams.
  • Comfort working in a global, remote-first environment with asynchronous collaboration.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 12 months, this leader will:

  • Maintain and improve SEO performance as a major organic acquisition channel.
  • Establish a clear GEO strategy, measurement model, and operating rhythm.
  • Improve Parallels visibility and recommendation presence across AI-powered discovery platforms.
  • Strengthen technical SEO foundations and content authority across priority product and audience segments.
  • Build durable collaboration between SEO, GEO, Product Marketing, Engineering, Content, Communications, Channel, and Analytics.
  • Create a repeatable experimentation framework for AI-driven discovery.
  • Position Parallels to win as traditional search and AI-driven discovery continue to converge.

About Parallels

Parallels is a global leader in cross-platform solutions, enabling businesses and individuals to access and use the applications, files, and workflows they need on any device or operating system.

Parallels helps customers get the best out of the technology they choose - whether that is Windows, Linux, macOS, ChromeOS, iOS, Android, or the cloud. Our products serve individuals, developers, power users, small and mid-size businesses, enterprises, public sector organizations, and educators who need simple, reliable, and cost-effective ways to work across platforms.

Parallels is best known for making complex technology feel simple. We solve deep engineering and user-experience challenges so customers can run the applications they need, where and how they need them - from Windows on Mac to managed enterprise environments and flexible hybrid work setups.

We have millions of users globally and decades of innovation behind us. Today, Parallels is focused on helping customers stay productive in a world where work happens across devices, operating systems, clouds, and increasingly AI-powered workflows.

We offer a fully remote workspace and flexible hours because we believe great work can happen anywhere. Our team is global, collaborative, and built around motivated people who care about solving meaningful customer problems.

Voor deze opdracht zoeken we een Support Engineer Media met een sterke interesse in media en technologie.

Als Support Engineer Media werk je dagelijks midden in het productieproces. Journalisten, monteurs en regisseurs kunnen technische problemen met vertrouwen bij jou neerleggen, waarna jij snel en doeltreffend in actie komt. Je lost technische incidenten zelf op of schakelt een collega-specialist in om de situatie zo snel mogelijk te herstellen.

Je biedt eerstelijnsondersteuning aan productiemedewerkers van verschillende redacties. Daarbij ondersteun je hen bij de technische middelen en faciliteiten die gebruikt worden binnen de radionetten, de nieuwsdienst en de tv-redacties. Je neemt ook een coördinerende rol op bij complexere problemen, waarbij je collega’s binnen de technologieafdeling aanstuurt om de dienstverlening snel te herstellen.

Daarnaast volg je technische projecten mee op, zoals nieuwe studio’s, uitzendsystemen en opnameapparatuur. Je test nieuwe systemen en apparatuur, documenteert je bevindingen en geeft opleiding aan eindgebruikers.

📝Jouw profiel

Je hebt een bachelor of master, bij voorkeur in een technische richting zoals industrieel ingenieur of informatica, of je bent gelijkwaardig door ervaring. Kandidaten met een audiovisuele opleiding en een goede kennis van IT en elektronica komen eveneens in aanmerking.

Je hebt ervaring in een mediaomgeving, broadcastomgeving of audiovisuele technische context. Je kan een technische omgeving operationeel ondersteunen en coördineren, en je bent vertrouwd met audio en video, montageprogramma’s en het verwerken van mediabestanden. Daarnaast heb je een goede kennis van Windows en macOS, en ben je vertrouwd met audio- en/of video-opnameapparatuur zoals microfoons, mengtafels en videocamera’s.

Je bent communicatief, klantgericht en stressbestendig. Je kan goed omgaan met feedback, hecht belang aan kwaliteit en neemt verantwoordelijkheid op. Je bent analytisch sterk, weet vragen correct te analyseren en zoekt doelgericht naar oplossingen. Daarnaast werk je graag samen, integreer je je vlot in een team en draag je bij aan gezamenlijke doelstellingen.

Je bent bereid om te werken in ochtend-, dag-, avond- en weekendshiften.

Er wordt veel belang gehecht aan een inclusieve werkomgeving waarin diversiteit wordt gewaardeerd en iedereen welkom is.

💼 Aanbod

Je zal deel uitmaken van een groeiende KMO met ruimte voor initiatief en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je in een uitdagende maar aangename werkomgeving terecht komt met leuke collega's. Samen met jou stippelen we een carriereplan uit, met aandacht en budget voor bijkomende opleidingingen / certificaties. Je kan rekenen op een motiverend salaris, aangevuld met extralegale voordelen, inclusief bedrijfswagen (of alternatieve vergoeding).

raw.description:
Fuse Energy is a forward-thinking renewable energy startup on a mission to deliver a terawatt of renewable energy – fast. We're combining first-principles thinking with cutting-edge technology to build a radically better energy system. We raised $210M from top-tier investors including Multicoin, Balderton, Lakestar, Accel, Creandum, Lowercarbon, Ribbit, Box Group and strategic angels like Nico Rosberg, the Co-Founder of Solana and GPs behind Meta, Revolut, Spotify, Uber and more.

We're creating a fully integrated energy company: from developing renewable generation and grid infrastructure to powering the next generation of AI and compute-intensive industries. But we’re not stopping there. We’re also building the Energy Network: a decentralised platform of smart devices to electrify our homes, shifting usage to off-peak hours and helping balance the grid. This network strengthens grid stability - a critical foundation for scaling AI data centers and other energy-intensive industries.

As AI drives unprecedented demand for power and data center capacity, the bottleneck is no longer chips – it is energy, grid infrastructure, and the ability to deliver new capacity at speed.

We are looking for a Data Center Development Lead to help solve that problem. You will be responsible for taking data center projects from concept through to Ready-to-Build and energisation. You will own the technical and development workstreams required to transform a site from an opportunity into a deliverable project. You will work across site selection, power strategy, grid connections, planning, engineering, design development, permitting, utility engagement, and delivery readiness.

This is a highly technical role for someone who understands both infrastructure development and engineering. You will help build the infrastructure that enables the next generation of AI.

BRIGHTSCOUT is a global B2B branding and development agency specializing in elevating emerging tech businesses through uniquely crafted brands and standout apps. Comprised of top-tier talent worldwide, we offer a powerful blend of exquisite design, robust development, and strategic acumen. More than a company, BRIGHTSCOUT is a tribe dedicated to disrupting the tech industry with bold ideas and collaborative genius.

The Role

As a UX/UI Designer at BRIGHTSCOUT, you’ll craft intuitive, impactful, and visually engaging digital experiences across websites, mobile and web apps, and interactive platforms. You’ll translate ideas into elegant, functional designs — from early concepts and wireframes to high-fidelity prototypes and final user interfaces.

You’ll collaborate closely with multidisciplinary teams to bring digital products to life, ensuring every interaction feels purposeful and aligned with our clients’ brand and business goals. User Experience

  • Develop personas, journey maps, user flows, and wireframes to visualize and communicate user behavior.
  • Collaborate with project managers, lead designers, messaging and strategy roles as well as developers to define MVP scope and project goals.
  • Translate requirements and feedback into clear, user-centered design solutions.
  • Iterate on designs based on user testing, analytics, and stakeholder input.

User Interface & Visual Design

  • Design responsive, high-quality user interfaces across web and mobile platforms.
  • Create components, layouts, and visual elements aligned with brand guidelines and design systems.
  • Produce prototypes that communicate interaction and motion intent.

Collaboration & Growth

  • Partner with UX/UI, brand & visual, motion and 3D designers to ensure consistency and creative cohesion.

Process & Improvement

  • Contribute to internal documentation, design libraries, and process improvements.
  • Support the refinement of BRIGHTSCOUT’s design systems and standards.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of experience in UX/UI design, preferably in a digital or creative agency environment.
  • Strong portfolio showcasing UX process, UI execution, and attention to detail.
  • Proficiency in Figma, FigJam, and Adobe Creative Suite.
  • Understanding of UX principles, responsive design, and accessibility best practices.
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills — able to present work clearly and confidently.
  • Ability to balance creativity, structure, and deadlines in a remote-first environment.

It's A Plus

  • Experience facilitating user research or usability testing.
  • Familiarity with analytics or data-driven design optimization.

Our Values

  • Bring Order to the Chaos: We transform complexity into clarity.

Why Us

Job Title:

Director, Strategic Partner Alliances

Job Description

We're Concentrix. The global technology and services leader that powers the world’s best brands, today and into the future. We’re solution-focused, tech-powered, intelligence-fueled. With unique data and insights, deep industry expertise, and advanced technology solutions, we’re the intelligent transformation partner that powers a world that works, helping companies become refreshingly simple to work, interact, and transact with. We shape new game-changing careers in over 70 countries, attracting the best talent. Join us and be part of this journey towards greater opportunities and brighter futures.

Our game-changers around the world have devoted their careers to ensuring every relationship is exceptional. And we’re proud to be recognized with awards such as "World's Best Workplaces," “Best Companies for Career Growth,” and “Best Company Culture,” year after year.

Join us and be part of this journey towards greater opportunities and brighter futures

The Strategic Partnerships & Alliance Manager drives growth through the development, commercialization, and scaling of high-impact partnerships across the technology ecosystem (e.g., Microsoft, NICE, Google). The role owns the full partnership lifecycle—from strategy and partner development through to co-sell execution, contracting, and long-term value creation.

What you will do in this role

In everything we do, we believe in doing right by and for people – our clients, their customers, our people, our community, and our planet.

Strategy & Alliance Development

• Identify, secure, and grow strategic partnerships aligned to business priorities

• Develop and execute joint business plans (JBPs) with measurable revenue and pipeline targets

• Define “better together” propositions across partner ecosystems

Commercial & Pursuit Leadership

• Drive co-sell motions and joint pipeline with partners (e.g., Microsoft, Google, NICE)

• Lead partner engagement in pursuits, RFPs, and client solutioning

• Negotiate and close partnership agreements with legal and finance

Program Delivery & Enablement

• Build scalable partner enablement programs, playbooks, and GTM frameworks

• Lead cross-functional execution (sales, marketing, product, delivery)

• Manage partnership programs against defined milestones and KPIs

Executive Relationship Management

• Build and influence senior stakeholder relationships across partner organisations

• Establish governance cadence (QBRs, exec briefings, joint steering)

• Act as primary escalation and alignment owner for partnerships

Innovation & Thought Leadership

• Co-create joint offerings leveraging AI, cloud, and platform capabilities

• Represent the business in partner and client forums

• Drive differentiated solutions aligned to market trends (e.g., AI, CCaaS, data)

Core Capabilities

• Strategic alliance and ecosystem management

• Structured thinking, partner enablement, and program design

• Strong project/program management discipline

• Executive stakeholder engagement and influence

• Commercial acumen and deal negotiation

• Pursuit leadership and revenue delivery

• Cross-functional collaboration and orchestration

• Technology-led innovation and thought leadership

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Revenue & Growth

• Partner-sourced / influenced revenue

• Joint pipeline and win rate

• Deal size uplift via partner engagement

Execution & Delivery

• JBP achievement (pipeline, revenue, adoption)

• Co-sell opportunities and partner attach rate

• On-time delivery of partnership initiatives

Partnership Health

• Executive engagement cadence and partner satisfaction

• Partner activation (time to first deal, enablement completion)

Commercial & Governance

• Contract cycle time and deal conversion

• Compliance with legal and financial frameworks

Your qualifications

We embrace our game-changers with open arms, people from diverse backgrounds, who are curious and willing to learn. Your natural talent to help others and go beyond WOW for our customers will fit right in with what we do and who we are.

Concentrix is a great match if you have:

  • Deep expertise in at least one strategic partner ecosystem (e.g. NICE, Microsoft, Google, Cognigy), with the ability to quickly build credibility across adjacent partner technologies.

  • Strong understanding of customer experience, business applications, cloud, data and AI value propositions.

  • Proven ability to shape differentiated joint solutions and propositions that address customer business outcomes.

  • Experience supporting bids, pitches, co-sell opportunities and go-to-market initiatives with partners.

  • Ability to translate partner capabilities into clear, compelling messaging for sales, solution, consulting and delivery teams.

  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build effective relationships and become productive quickly within partner organisations.

  • Commercially minded, with the ability to identify opportunities for growth, differentiation and joint customer value.

Success Profile

• Strategic thinker with strong execution discipline

• Highly collaborative and influential in complex environments

• Commercially driven with strong deal-making capability

• Structured and methodical in building scalable partnership models

• Credible technology partner with strong ecosystem understanding

What’s in it for you

We challenge conventions to deliver outcomes unimagined by creating customer experiences that go beyond WOW.

In this role, we offer benefits that help support your unique lifestyle:

  • Remote working

  • Competitive Salary

Ready to bring your legal and editorial expertise into the AI era?

Do you want to play a key role in shaping how AI transforms legal content development?

About the Team

LexisNexis Legal & Professional, which serves customers in more than 150 countries with 11,800 employees worldwide, is part of RELX, a global provider of information-based analytics and decision tools for professional and business customers. Our company has been a long-time leader in deploying AI and advanced technologies to the legal market to improve productivity and transform the overall business and practice of law, deploying ethical and powerful generative AI solutions with a flexible, multi-model approach that prioritizes using the best model from today’s top model creators for each individual legal use case.

About the Role

We’re looking for a highly collaborative and detail-oriented US Legal Editor, AI Content Updating to join the Global Analytical Editorial Operations team. In this role you will curate, enhance, and expand authoritative US legal analysis by partnering with expert authors and leveraging AI-enabled editorial tools to ensure legal commentary and analysis remains accurate, current, and useful.

You’ll combine sharp legal insight with strong project and relationship management skills to ensure that our products deliver comprehensive and timely guidance to our customers. A central focus of the role is the thoughtful, day-to-day use of AI tools to support content commissioning, research, drafting, review, and updating at scale. You will apply editorial judgment to review and refine AI-generated outputs before publication, contribute subject-matter insight to the testing and improvement of those tools, and encourage authors and contributors to adopt AI-supported workflows effectively.

Core responsibilities include owning author relationships, content management, and AI-enabled content updating, with a focus on maximizing content currency through real-time updates following legislative, case law, and regulatory developments.

Responsibilities

Author & Contributor Relationships

  • Recruit, onboard, and support top external authors in the field, fostering strong relationships with trusted subject matter experts and positioning LexisNexis as a preferred publishing partner. Set clear expectations for scope, style, quality, and delivery timelines, and provide ongoing guidance and feedback to drive consistent, high-value content aligned to portfolio and customer needs.

  • Maintain productive long-term relationships, intervening early to resolve performance issues or revise author mix as needed; manage contributor contracts within approved budgets.

  • Encourage and support authors’ effective use of Lexis+ Protégé and provide guidance on quality standards for AI-assisted content.

Domain Expertise & Content Planning

  • Track legislative, regulatory, and case-law developments to keep content current, understand emerging trends, and identify white-space opportunities for new content.

  • Manage portfolio delivery plans, collaborating with Content Operations to balance quality, speed, and cost.

AI-Enabled Editorial & Content Updating

  • Use Agentic Content Platform as an integral part of everyday editorial workflows, applying editorial judgment to evaluate, refine, and approve outputs before publication.

  • Provide substantive and structural updates and edits, ensuring accuracy, clarity, consistency, and cross-platform functionality.

  • Contribute subject-matter insight to the testing, evaluation, and continuous improvement of AI tools used for content development and updating.

  • Contribute to cross-functional initiatives such as new product pilots, author recruitment, Lexis+ Protégé answer quality analysis.

Product & Market Alignment

  • Partner with Product Managers, Content Strategy, and Segment teams to ensure alignment with market needs; monitor customer feedback and analytics to make improvements.

  • Act as subject matter expert for assigned practice areas, supplying requirements for customer-facing features and workflow improvements.

  • Support Marketing and Sales with subject-matter expertise to enhance marketing collateral and product positioning.

Requirements

  • Education – J.D. required.

  • Experience – 1–5 years of legal practice, legal publishing, or comparable legal content development experience, along with a desire to develop professional depth of understanding in other practice areas.

  • Editorial Excellence – Demonstrated ability to edit complex legal analysis for clarity, consistency, and voice.

  • AI & Tech Fluency – Confidence working with AI-enabled tools for legal research, document summarization, content drafting, and editorial review. Skilled at crafting prompts, evaluating outputs, iterating for optimal results, and contributing to the improvement of AI-supported workflows

  • Commercial Mindset – Ability to interpret market signals, customer feedback, and data to inform content initiatives and drive sustainable growth.

  • Communication & Adaptability – Clear, positive communicator who thrives on collaborating with stakeholders and partners; executes on commitments, pivots quickly as needed, and views setbacks as learning opportunities.

Work in a way that works for you

We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, and study assistance, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.

About the Business

LexisNexis Legal & Professional® provides legal, regulatory, and business information and analytics that help customers increase their productivity, improve decision-making, achieve better outcomes, and advance the rule of law around the world. As a digital pioneer, the company was the first to bring legal and business information online with its Lexis® and Nexis® services.

Your mission is to translate vision and complex business requirements into detailed technical blueprints for model selection, API & data orchestration, and agentic logic. You act as a key bridge between sales and delivery, working closely with customers and Google channel partners to design scalable, governed, and high-performing systems leveraging Gemini Enterprise and Vertex AI.

  • MLOps & Data Governance: Define standards for MLOps and data orchestration, ensuring AI models are securely integrated with corporate data estates and comply with GCP best practices.

  • Technical Quality Control: Perform deep-dive architectural reviews of AI projects to ensure adherence to Google Cloud best practices.

Required Qualifications:

  • 12+ years in technical architecture with a focus on AI, Data, Integration, and consultative leadership

  • Expert-level knowledge of Gemini Enterprise (formerly Agent space), Vertex AI, and Big Query ML

  • Proven experience in customer-facing roles, with the ability to influence CXO stakeholders and lead technical solutioning for AI-driven business transformations

  • Proven experience in Prompt Design & Engineering (ideally with Gemini) and tuning LLM-based systems for specific behaviors and safety constraints

  • Deep understanding of Python-based AI orchestration (Lang Graph, ADK, etc.)

Desired Qualifications:

  • Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer certification.

  • Experience with high-performance computing (HPU/TPU) and specialized AI hardware on GCP
